notes.title: Passenger Transport Mission – First Iteration
notes.content: [p]Hello Captains,[/p][p][/p][p]With our latest update [b]v0.8.3[/b], we’ve introduced the very first iteration of [b]Passenger Transport Missions[/b] in [i]Ships At Sea[/i]. This is an exciting new step for us, and although it is still in its early phase, it already lays the foundation for much bigger things to come.[/p][p][/p][h3]First Iteration – What’s In Now[/h3][p]In this version, you’ll be able to pick up and transport a few NPC passengers. The mission is fully playable, but as with all first iterations, there’s room for improvement. We’re already planning refinements such as:[/p][list][*][p]More polish to the overall mechanic[/p][/*][*][p]Better feedback and immersion for the player[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][previewyoutube="zllA_H5RTDw;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]Next Steps – Expanding the Experience[/h3][p]We’ve already started work on the next evolution of passenger gameplay:[/p][list][*][p][b]Kiosk on Tier 3 Service Ship[/b] – You will be able to run a small onboard kiosk to serve your passengers. Items such as snacks and drinks can be purchased from the tool shop—everything from pizza to kanel snuter—so you can stock your kiosk with plenty of variety. With this approach, we’re opening up for a more authentic ship operation experience while sailing.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Passenger Satisfaction[/b] – Rewards will later be tied not only to completing the mission, but also to how happy your passengers are with the journey. The better you take care of them, the more rewarding the experience will be.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/fd0b85fcfa909a2ab44ea70187eabfaeceb2f8ee.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/c03e573af4dad18ecd791870a1309ed5d1399679.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Looking Ahead – Ferry Operations[/h3][p]The Passenger Transport Mission is more than just a small side activity—it sets the groundwork for [b]ferry operations[/b]. In future updates, you won’t just transport a handful of passengers, but also vehicles and larger groups, adding depth and variety to your gameplay.[/p][p][/p][h3]Final Thoughts[/h3][p]This is just the beginning of a new gameplay layer in [i]Ships At Sea[/i]. As with all features in Early Access, your feedback will be vital in shaping how the game evolves. We’re eager to keep expanding the systems and activities available to you, bringing even more depth and variety to ship operations, and we look forward to sharing more as development progresses.[/p][p][/p][p]See you at sea, [/p][p][/p][p][b]Misc Games Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: Update v0.8.3 - Live Now!
notes.content:
[p][b]Ahoy Captains![/b][/p][p]After a successful run on the Public Test branch the last weeks, we’re excited to announce that [b]Update v0.8.3 is now live for everyone![/b] This update brings a mix of new features, gameplay improvements, and important fixes based on your feedback during testing. Thank you to all who joined the Public Test and helped us polish the experience — now it’s time for the whole community to set sail with the latest changes.[/p][p][/p][p]Before we dive into the exciting details of [b]Update v0.8.3[/b], there’s something important we want to highlight.[/p][p][/p][h2]💾 [b]Updated Save System[/b][/h2][p]
Your progress matters to us, and we want to be transparent: save files from version 0.7.5 are [b]not compatible[/b] with the new system introduced in v0.8.3. To make sure you can continue your journey, we’ve prepared a branch that lets you safely upgrade your old saves and profiles with the official release of v0.8.3: [/p][p][b]How to upgrade your save:[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Switch to the branch [b]v0.8.2[/b] on Steam[/p][/*][*][p]Password: [b]ZeroEightTwo[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Load your old save in this version and save it again[/p][/*][*][p]Upgrade to [b]v0.8.3[/b] and continue playing with your updated save[/p][/*][/olist][p]We understand that this adds an extra step, but reworking the save system was necessary to provide us with the flexibility to introduce more complex features, resolve long-standing issues, and deliver a more reliable and stable game moving forward.[/p][p][/p][h2]🌍 [b]Expanded Language Support[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We’re thrilled to announce that [b]Ships At Sea[/b] now supports even more languages! With this update, you can set sail in [b]Polish, Turkish, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and Brazilian Portuguese[/b].[/p][p]This expansion makes the game more accessible to players worldwide, and we’re excited to welcome many new captains into our growing maritime community.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/2249b269aa078a4a2905f7a6ee78c2bd1832786e.png"][/img][/p][p]In addition, we’ve improved localization across the game by refining [b]German, French, Italian, Spanish, and Russian[/b] translations for greater accuracy and clarity.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/217d3b5c7b103d80b2928fc4dcd1090e7a415c8c.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Reworked Mooring System – Dock Anywhere![/b][/h2][p][/p][p]With the reworked mooring system, docking is no longer tied to fixed black markers — you can now moor at any available point around the map. We’ve also added more mooring points across ports, giving you greater freedom when bringing your ship into harbour, including the ability to overlap mooring if needed. [/p][p]You still have the option to [b]start your engine while docked[/b], giving you the manoeuvring ability when departing from the moorings, like in real life.  This update improves save stability as well, fixing issues such as ships tilting after loading a save too close to the harbour.[/p][p][/p][quote][p][i][b]Note:[/b] Fixed markers remain at fish farms for now as placeholders, simply showing that docking is possible even though the new system is active there.[/i][/p][/quote][p][/p][previewyoutube="i0Rn5D9MyI4;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Harbors now feature three distinct mooring types for small, mid-sized, and large vessels, enhancing authenticity. In upcoming updates, realistic mooring ropes will dynamically connect ships to shore, eliminating the “floating” effect and adding new immersion to docking and towing. We’re basing this on real practices: ropes tied with a cleat hitch on smaller piers, or secured with a round turn around a bollard at mid-sized ports. These details will make docking feel both complete and true to real harbour life.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/8ba7e8f2b27d3d993193679ee301784cd8bbfebb.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Improved Crane Handling & Physics[/h2][p][/p][p]With Update v0.8.3, we’ve improved cargo operation physics, enhancing crane handling as well as loading and unloading. Issues where cargo behaved unpredictably on the hook or clipped through the ship or port floor have been resolved. Crane operations now feel smoother, more stable, and much closer to an authentic cargo-handling experience.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="E7LcqWCGsvE;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2][b]Improved Interaction System[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]The interaction system has been reworked to feel clearer and more responsive. Objects you can interact with are now easier to spot thanks to new visual cues like interaction dots and highlighters, while updated tooltips provide better guidance when engaging with different elements.[/p][p]For greater flexibility, you can now customize exactly how these features appear — toggle interaction indicators, object names, and backgrounds on or off, adjust highlighter brightness, and fine-tune the radial fade-out effect. Whether you prefer a clean, minimal interface or prominent prompts, the choice is yours![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/1f6f5868aaa34c2560c22e9740eeb5b273d314fe.png"][/img][/p][p]This isn't just a visual update—it's the foundation for smarter, more intuitive interaction across the entire game as we head toward larger, more complex ships and deeper gameplay systems.[/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/61566090e180c08e7641373ce0022e6d0d9dbda9.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/4812523ff17aaa3b1312de7a0e992f94f27c3e91.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/41f05d5841b25f408644f165e0c0cd173b8a1ff2.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][h2][b]Crew System – First Iteration[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]With update v0.8.3, we’re introducing the very first iteration of the [b]Crew System[/b], starting with the Tier 3 fishing ship. This is a long-awaited feature, especially for players who enjoy single-player mode and want extra hands on deck.[/p][p]Crew members can now take over essential tasks, such as:[/p][list][*][p]Hauling and hooking fish[/p][/*][*][p]Gutting and sorting fish[/p][/*][*][p]Baiting and preparing longlines (the player still decides when to deploy them)[/p][/*][/list][quote][p][i][b]Note:[/b] Tier 1 and Tier 2 boats do not support NPC crew due to limited space. Larger vessels provide more room and greater responsibility — just like in real life.[/i][/p][/quote][p][/p][h3]How does it work?[/h3][p][/p][p]To hire NPC crew, first activate your Tier 3 fishing ship, rig it for longline fishing, and then visit the office. Once hired, crew can be assigned directly to your vessel through the [b]Crew Chart[/b] and [b]Assignment Tab[/b] in the company logbook. These systems are still a work in progress, with visuals and functionality to be refined in future updates.[/p][p]You’ll need [b]two crew members[/b] for each task slot — one as the supervisor and one as the worker. Make sure your boat’s inventory contains all the necessary items (bait, knife, hook, etc.), so your crew can equip themselves and carry out their tasks properly.[/p][p]Finally, simply drag and drop the desired task onto the crew slot, and they’ll get to work.[/p][quote][p][i][b]Note:[/b] If the hauling task is started by the player (e.g., using the remote gear control), crew members will not continue it. This is known and will be addressed in an upcoming updates. [/i][/p][/quote][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/b3978d85ab5c77fe00cb07e4bb25532434e6dc8b.png"][/img][/p][p]You can already hire crew for Tier 3 service and cargo ships, [b]but they don’t perform tasks yet[/b] — rest assured, this functionality will be added in upcoming updates! [/p][p]We’ll continue to refine the crew system, enhance the interface, and improve navigation and pathfinding to make tasks feel more natural and seamless. Once the core character mechanics are complete, we’ll also add task-specific animations to enrich the experience further.[/p][p]We also plan to extend the system to support NPC-controlled vehicles and vessels — not only for the upcoming ferry operations, but also to make the seas feel even more alive.[/p][p][/p][h2]Unloading Fish Boxes – Mast Crane Integration[/h2][p][/p][p]Tier 3 vessels now support unloading fish boxes at the harbour using the mast crane — an important new step in the fish production line. Blue fish boxes are treated as [b]medium cargo[/b] and can be dropped off in the designated medium cargo area or at the fishery. [/p][p]At this stage, interaction with individual boxes (to select and trade specific fish species at the fishery) is not yet implemented. For now, all sorted boxes will spawn in the unloading area beneath the hatch. The fishery UI features a [b]temporary sell button[/b], which will later be replaced with a proper shop interface. If the sell button is greyed out, it means there are currently no fish available to trade.[/p][p]We’ve also added a small detail for extra realism: the [b]small hatch under the bleeding box[/b] now animates, opening and closing as fish are moved from the bleeding box into the production line.[/p][p][b]How it works:[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Sort fish into boxes[/p][/*][*][p]Head to the work deck and press the button to clear the space around the hatch[/p][/*][*][p]Hatch opens and spawns fish boxes below[/p][/*][*][p]Use the mast crane to unload them at the port (ship must be docked)[/p][/*][*][p]The hatch will not open if crew or obstructions are in the way — safety first![/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][previewyoutube="_prAFuUma2I;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/6d68b7c3ef04bed407155e6c774519fe472aa041.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/cf6d2349e4b8a142acd841261343ec86e0fd43cf.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][h2][b]Passenger Transport Missions Arrive[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Passenger transport gameplay has now officially launched with Update v0.8.3, following its successful run in the Public Test branch. [/p][p]To begin, visit the office at one of the ports (Røst, Værøy, Skomvær, and Mosken) and accept a passenger transport mission. From there, meet your passengers at the dock, interact with them, and guide them aboard your vessel.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/8703790d8d7b84906b354f54df8dd4ffccfaf916.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Once on board, NPC passengers will take their seats in the passenger area and perform fitting animations during the journey, bringing new life and activity to your ship. This marks the first step in passenger transport; future features will expand tasks to include operating a kiosk on the Tier 3 service vessel, ultimately leading to full-scale ferry operations on the upcoming Tier 4 ferry vessel.[/p][p][/p][quote][p][b]Known Issues:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Passengers may clip or fail to re-board after visiting the shipyard.[/p][/*][*][p]Multiple missions, combined with save/load, can cause incorrect counters, result in all passengers being delivered to a single port, or lead to premature mission completion.[/p][/*][*][p]Mission rewards currently appear doubled.[/p][/*][/list][p]We’re aware of these issues and will address them in upcoming updates.[/p][/quote][p][/p][h2]🏢 [b]Warehouses[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]With Update v0.8.3, every port now features a [b]warehouse with unlimited storage[/b], managed by an interactable NPC worker. You’ll find the warehouse worker outside, giving you direct access to your stored cargo.[/p][p]Warehouses provide greater flexibility for cargo missions:[/p][list][*][p][b]Move cargo into the warehouse[/b] – Request to store your own cargo, or even another company’s cargo, from the port’s cargo area. If at least one active player is present, a vote will begin, and once confirmed, the cargo will be transferred into storage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Transfer cargo back to the port[/b] – Request unloading from the warehouse, and the cargo will be placed in the first available cargo area.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Delete cargo[/b] – You may permanently remove your own cargo from storage if needed.[/p][/*][/list][p]One of the biggest advantages: if you sell your boat with loaded cargo during an active mission, your cargo items won’t be lost. Instead, they are automatically transferred to your company's warehouse, allowing you to continue your mission with another cargo vessel. [/p][p][/p][quote][p][i][b]Note:[/b] Leaving companies does not transfer items to the new company.[/i][/p][/quote][p][/p][h3]Interactable NPC Warehouse Worker[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/fb86c28f025c81515c3fc7324d5db8abde6a2375.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Moving Cargo to the Warehouse[/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="r-sKaZTphcw;full"][/previewyoutube][h3]Transferring Cargo Back from the Warehouse to the Port[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/82475b5667dd9a940cc64aeab117a3627c4fac43.png"][/img][/p][h2]Dynamic Markers[/h2][p][/p][p]Mission markers have been reworked to reduce clutter. Previously, all icons — including pickup, drop-off, and destination points — appeared both in the world and on the compass at once. Now, the compass only displays markers for distant objectives outside your visual range, while nearby objectives show their world icon instead. Markers now update dynamically. [/p][p]We’ve also added new mission icons for better clarity. Please note that the UI will continue to evolve as the game develops, even after version 1.0 is released. [/p][p][/p][h2]Longline Length Deployment[/h2][p][/p][p]We have improved the longline setting, where the displayed line length decreases if the captain zigzags or turns back toward the first buoy. The system had been measuring straight-line distance instead of the actual gear spooled out. This has now been improved — the longline continues to unspool correctly regardless of the vessel's heading.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/3770a89f7533dcaa1a1dc8165ff57e069d47cd5e.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Rust Build-Up Adjusted[/h2][p][/p][p]We’ve modified the rust system across all ships so that dust and rust accumulate more gradually, making it take much longer for vessels to appear worn.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/2d7d9e672078f992a839fdab07c01baed119586f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Handheld Radio [/h2][p][/p][p]The handheld radio is functional, but at certain distances it may not work reliably. Please keep this in mind when using it — the issue will be addressed with the upcoming map update.[/p][h2][/h2][h2]Changelog v0.8.3.1510[/h2][list][*][p]Added information in the help for crew management[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue with the crew that can get stuck on the ladder on Turbo[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing translation in Weather Settings for storm[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Changelog save game system (note: saves from v0.7.5 are not compatible)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Behind the Scenes[/h2][p][/p][p]We’re already working on the next set of features and improvements. As a brief teaser, we’ve included a video of our new map, showcasing a redesigned office layout, enhanced environments, and a new weather system to boost immersion. The map also brings improved graphics and overall lighting, along with new ports to dock and explore. [/p][p]In addition, we’re working on dedicated server support that goes beyond the current friends list system, making it easier to connect with players worldwide and grow your own maritime community. We’re also refining ship physics and steering, improving boat capacity so you’ll always know exactly how much your vessel can carry, enhancing the UI, and much more still to come.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="8zXJQLOxLM4;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Stay tuned, captains — we’ll keep shaping [b]Ships At Sea[/b] together and look forward to what’s coming next![/p][p]Fair Winds and Happy Sailing. [/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Team Misc Games[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Public Test - Update v0.8.3
notes.content: [p]Ahoy Skippers,[/p][p]We’re excited to announce that the [b]Public Test [/b]for[b] Update v0.8.3[/b] is now open![/p][p]This update introduces a wave of exciting new features and improvements — including support for five additional languages, a completely reworked mooring system, the first iteration of the NPC crew system, and a major step forward in the fish production line with the ability to unload your catch at the port. [/p][p][/p][p]To avoid any potential issues, [b]we strongly recommend backing up your save files[/b] before switching to the Public Test version v0.8.3.[/p][p][b]To find your Steam for Ships At Sea saves:[/b] [/p][list][*][p] Press Win + E [/p][/*][*][p] Paste %USERPROFILE%/AppData/Local/Sas/Saved/SaveGames into the search bar. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]To try the PUBLIC TEST, please follow these steps:[/b][/p][list][*][p] Open Steam [/p][/*][*][p] Right-click on Ships At Sea in your library [/p][/*][*][p] Select Properties [/p][/*][*][p] Go to the Betas tab [/p][/*][*][p] Enter the password: [i]SaSPublicTest[/i] [/p][/*][*][p] Choose "public_test" from the "Beta participation" drop-down list [/p][/*][*][p] Wait for the game to update the files (if nothing happens, restart the Steam client) [/p][/*][*][p] Launch the game [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]💾 Updated Save System[/h2][p]We understand the importance of your progress, so we want to be fully transparent: [b]save files from version 0.7.5 will not be compatible[/b] with the new system introduced in version 0.8.3.[/p][p]To ensure you can continue playing with your old saves from v0.7.5, we will prepare a branch v0.8.2 that allows you to upgrade them safely when v0.8.3 is officially released to everyone.[/p][p]We understand this may be inconvenient, but reworking the save system is a crucial step. It provides us with the flexibility to introduce more complex and exciting features, resolve long-standing issues, and make the game more reliable and stable going forward.[/p][p][/p][h2]Reworked Mooring System – Dock Anywhere![/h2][p]With the reworked mooring system, docking is no longer restricted to fixed markers — you’re now free to tie up at any available mooring point around the map. We’ve added more mooring points across ports, so docking is no longer limited to predefined spots, and even overlapping docking is possible, giving you more flexibility when bringing your ship into harbour. [/p][p][i][b]Please note:[/b] The fixed visual markers are still present at the fish farms, even though they now support the new mooring system. These markers are only placeholders at the moment to guide you and indicate that docking at the fish farm is possible.[/i][/p][p]Harbours feature three distinct mooring types, preparing them for small, mid-sized, and larger vessels in a way that feels more realistic. This new system also improves save stability, preventing issues such as ships tilting when docked too close to the harbour after loading a save. Looking ahead, we’re working on realistic mooring ropes that will dynamically connect the ship to the shore, eliminating the “floating” effect and adding a new layer of immersion to the docking and towing of objects. [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="i0Rn5D9MyI4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]👨‍✈️ Crew System – First Iteration of Crew Task[/h2][p]The [b]Tier 3 fishing ship[/b] can now hold crew members — a long-awaited feature, especially for those who play in single-player mode.[/p][list][*][p]Crew can be assigned tasks such as:[/p][list][*][p]Hauling and hooking fish[/p][/*][*][p]Gutting and sorting fish[/p][/*][*][p]Baiting and preparing longlines [i](with the player deciding when to deploy them into the water)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Note:[/b] Tier 1 and 2 boats do not support NPC crew due to their limited space. Larger vessels offer more room, greater responsibility, and the ability to hire a crew — just like in real life. [/p][/*][*][p]To hire an NPC crew member, activate your Tier 3 fishing ship, rig it for longline fishing, and visit the office. Once hired, you can assign them directly to your ship.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Crew chart[/b] and [b]Assignment tab[/b] can be accessed through the company logbook. It is still in mockup form — functionality and visuals are still in work in progress and will be improved in future releases. We welcome your feedback![/p][/*][*][p]You need two crew members to assign to the slot; one serves as the supervisor, overseeing the tasks of the other crew members. [u]Ensure that all necessary items, such as bait, a knife, or a hook, are placed in your boat’s inventory so the crew can equip themselves and complete their tasks![/u][/p][/*][*][p][b]Task-specific animations[/b] have not yet been added. Once the mechanics for the main characters are largely complete, we will extend support to include the NPC crew as well.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/b3978d85ab5c77fe00cb07e4bb25532434e6dc8b.png"][/img][/p][h2]Unloading Fish Boxes – Mast Crane Integration[/h2][p]Fish boxes from Tier 3 vessels can now be unloaded at the harbour using the mast crane. Adding the next step to the fish production line. Blue fish boxes are treated as medium cargo and can be dropped in the medium cargo area. [/p][p]This stage, which involves interaction with individual boxes to select and trade specific fish species (box) at the fishery, is not yet implemented. This means that, for now, all sorted boxes will spawn in the unloading area under the hatch. The fishery UI includes a temporary sell button, which will later be replaced with a new shop interface. If the sell button is greyed out, it means there are no fish available to trade with the fishery. [/p][p]Finally, we’ve added [b]animations for the lever under the bleeding box[/b]. As soon as you move fish from the bleeding box into the production line, the lever now opens and closes to transfer the fish into the production area, adding a bit more realism to the process.[/p][list][*][p][b]How it works:[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Finish sorting fish into boxes[/p][/*][*][p]Head to the work deck and press the button to clear the space around the hatch[/p][/*][*][p]Hatch opens and spawns fish boxes below[/p][/*][*][p]Use the mast crane to unload at the port (ship must be docked)[/p][/*][*][p]Hatch won’t open if crew or obstructions are in the way (safety first!)[/p][/*][/olist][/*][/list][p][/p][previewyoutube="_prAFuUma2I;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/cf6d2349e4b8a142acd841261343ec86e0fd43cf.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/499016424d4325aa69e5e0ad8f33925db9c94eda.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/6d68b7c3ef04bed407155e6c774519fe472aa041.jpg"][/img][/carousel][h2]Passenger Transport Missions Arrive[/h2][p]We’re excited to introduce the very first iteration of passenger transport gameplay! This new feature is available on the [b]Tier 3 service ship[/b].[/p][p]To begin a mission, interact with the office at the port to accept your job. Once you’ve taken a passenger transport mission, you’ll need to meet the passengers at the port, interact with them, and guide them aboard your vessel.[/p][p]Once on board the ship, the NPCs will take their seats in the passenger area and play fitting animations during the journey, bringing the ship to life in new ways. This is just the beginning of passenger transport, and we look forward to hearing your feedback as we continue to expand and refine this system.[/p][p][i]Please note: saving for passenger missions is not yet implemented, so we recommend completing the mission before ending your session.[/i] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/7a190202af1475512a85b5f89bd6850f02147966.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/37f80a55f9d2cf9d17c4ae70b4c2b44eecb3cbb4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]🌍 Expanded Language Support [/h2][p][/p][p]We’re pleased to announce support for [b]five new languages[/b]: [b]Polish, Turkish, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, and Korean, [/b]as well as[b] Brazilian Portuguese[/b]. This update makes [i]Ships At Sea[/i] more accessible to players around the world, and we’re excited to welcome even more captains into our growing maritime community.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/2249b269aa078a4a2905f7a6ee78c2bd1832786e.png"][/img][/p][p]In addition, we’ve enhanced localization across the game, refining languages such as [b]German, French, Italian, Spanish,[/b] and [b]Russian[/b] for greater accuracy and clarity.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/217d3b5c7b103d80b2928fc4dcd1090e7a415c8c.png"][/img][/p][p]Upcoming updates will introduce additional language options to make Ships At Sea more accessible to everyone![/p][p][/p][h2]🏢 Warehouses[/h2][p]With [b]v0.8.3[/b], every port will now feature a [b]warehouse with unlimited storage[/b], managed by an interactable NPC warehouse worker. You’ll find the worker in front of the warehouse, where they provide direct access to your warehouse inventory.[/p][p]Warehouses give players more flexibility with cargo missions:[/p][list][*][p][b]Move cargo into the warehouse[/b] – You can request to move your own cargo, or even another company’s cargo, from the cargo area into storage. If at least one active player is present, a vote will begin. Once confirmed, the cargo is transferred to the warehouse.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Transfer cargo back to the port[/b] – You can also request unloading from the warehouse. Once done, the cargo will be placed in the first available cargo area.[/p][/*][*][p]Additionally, you have the option to [b]delete[/b] your own cargo from the warehouse permanently.[/p][/*][/list][p]And here’s the big benefit: if you sell your boat with loaded cargo during an active mission, your cargo items are [b]not lost[/b]. Instead, they’re automatically transferred into your warehouse inventory so that you can continue your mission with another boat or ship. [i](Note: changing companies does not transfer items to the new company.)[/i][/p][p]This system ensures that your progress is never wasted, while also enhancing authenticity and cooperation in cargo handling during multiplayer.[/p][p][/p][h3]Interactable NPC Warehouse Worker[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/fb86c28f025c81515c3fc7324d5db8abde6a2375.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Moving Cargo to the Warehouse[/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="r-sKaZTphcw;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]Transferring Cargo Back from the Warehouse to the Port[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/82475b5667dd9a940cc64aeab117a3627c4fac43.png"][/img][/p][h2]Enhanced Interactivity at Your Fingertips[/h2][p]We’ve made significant improvements to the interaction system in general, adding new visual cues such as [b]interaction dots[/b] and [b]highlighters[/b] to make it clearer what objects can be interacted with in the world. New [b]tooltips[/b] have also been introduced to provide helpful context when engaging with different elements. [/p][p]To give players more control, we’ve added options to toggle interaction indicators, object names and backgrounds on or off, as well as adjust the intensity of the highlighters and the smooth radial fadeout of the indicators—making the experience as subtle or as visible as you prefer.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/61566090e180c08e7641373ce0022e6d0d9dbda9.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Resolved Issue – XP Reset to 0 for Clients[/h2][p]We’ve addressed an issue where players joining a session as a client could sometimes see their XP reset to 0 and be unable to gain more. This should now be resolved, but since it was a rare and inconsistent problem, we ask that you test it out and let us know if you encounter it again.[/p][p] If you still experience this issue as a client, please send feedback through the in-game feedback system and include your log files so we can investigate further.[/p][p][i]Note: Players who have already reached level 100 have completed the progression system and will no longer earn additional XP, which is working as intended.[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]Improved Crane Handling & Physics[/h2][p]We’ve also improved the overall physics for cargo operations, including crane handling, loading, and unloading. The previous issues where cargo items could behave erratically on the hook or clip through the ship or port floor have been addressed. With these changes, crane operations should now feel smoother, more stable, and much closer to an authentic cargo-handling experience.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="9C-v5w7JIlI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]Feedback Form[/h2][p]For feedback or bug reports, please use our newly designed in-game feedback form or leave a report in our Discord server - bug channel: [url="https://discordapp.com/channels/887802577863975002/1245087354503299143"]https://discordapp.com/channels/887802577863975002/1245087354503299143[/url]. [/p][p]When submitting, please ensure that you select whether you were playing as a host, client, or in single-player mode. Include a brief summary and the steps to reproduce the issue, and don’t forget to attach your log files—this will help us track down and fix problems much faster.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/f7bc17d10b5a3aa93dad6a0735146dc0f721c213.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Changelog[/h2][p][/p][h3]New Features[/h3][list][*][p]Handheld radio now cancels any ongoing towing notes.title: New Mooring System in Update v0.8.3
notes.content: [p]Hello Captains,[/p][p]We’re excited to share some big news: the [b]mooring system has been completely reworked[/b] in [i]Ships At Sea[/i]![/p][p][/p][h3]🌊 Dock Anywhere, Not Just on Markers[/h3][p]Gone are the days of fixed docking visuals around ports. With the new system, you’re free to dock at [b]any available mooring[/b]. No more awkwardly lining up with black markers — as soon as you’re within the correct distance to the mooring, you can tie up your vessel.[/p][p]We’ve also added [b]more mooring points[/b] across the ports. This means docking is no longer restricted to predefined spots, and even [b]overlapping docking[/b] is possible. You’ll have more freedom and flexibility when bringing your ship into harbor.[/p][p]Not only does this make docking smoother and more immersive, it also prevents issues like ships tilting after loading a save game.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="i0Rn5D9MyI4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]🌍 A More Immersive Experience[/h3][p]The upcoming Update v0.8.3 improves not just the gameplay flow, but also the [b]look and feel of ports[/b]. Harbors are now cleaner and more authentic, free from cluttered docking visuals. Wherever you see a mooring, you know there’s a docking area — giving you the freedom to choose your spot and making ports feel more alive than ever.[/p][p][/p][h3]⚓ Three Mooring Types[/h3][p][i]Ships At Sea[/i] now features [b]three distinct mooring types[/b], preparing harbors for the wide variety of vessels:[/p][list][*][p][b]Small Moorings (Cleats)[/b] – Typically found on smaller metal piers, perfect for compact boats[/p][/*][*][p][b]Medium Moorings[/b] – Common in mid-sized ports, suited for most vessels[/p][/*][*][p][b]Large Moorings (Bollards)[/b] – Built with future, larger ships in mind, offering the space and stability needed for larger vessels[/p][/*][/list][p]This system lays the foundation for the future. Some ports will only accommodate small or mid-sized ships, while others are capable of handling much larger vessels — making harbor layouts more realistic. [/p][p][/p][h3]Realistic Docking Ropes (Work in Progress)[/h3][p]In addition to the new mooring system, we’re also reworking how docking ropes behave. Right now, ropes can sometimes appear to “float” when towing an object or securing your vessel. Our goal is to have ropes connect dynamically between ship and shore, removing the floating effect and adding a new layer of authenticity to docking and towing.[/p][p]To achieve this, we’re implementing real-world mooring practices. For example, you’ll see ropes tied with a [b]cleat hitch[/b] on smaller piers, or secured with a [b]round turn[/b] around a bollard for mid-sized ports. These authentic details will make every docking feel complete, but also feel true to real harbour life. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/8ba7e8f2b27d3d993193679ee301784cd8bbfebb.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This feature won’t be ready for [b]v0.8.3[/b], but development is underway, and we’re excited to bring it to you in a future update once it’s ready. In the meantime, we’re aiming to open up the [b]public test [/b]for[b] v0.8.3 [/b]on [b]Friday, August 29th[/b], and we’re really looking forward to hearing your feedback. [/p][p][/p][p]The reworked mooring system is just one step toward our larger vision for [i]Ships At Sea[/i]. With your feedback and support, we’ll continue to expand, improve, and make the game the most authentic maritime experience possible. See you on the docks this Friday![/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Team Misc Games[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Welcoming Torghatten & Multi Maritime Aboard – Ferry Operations Are Coming!
notes.content: [p]Ahoy Captains,[/p][p]We’re incredibly proud to share a major milestone in the development of [i]Ships At Sea[/i].[/p][p]We are honoured to welcome [b]Torghatten[/b], one of Norway’s oldest and largest ferry operators, as the official owner of our first in-game ferry. With decades of maritime history behind them, Torghatten represents the very heart of Norwegian ferry transport — and now they’re part of [i]Ships At Sea[/i].[/p][p]Equally exciting, the ferry itself has been designed by [b]Multi Maritime[/b], a renowned Norwegian ship design firm known for its innovation and passion for vessel development. With a long list of successful ship designs to their name — including many built for Torghatten — Multi Maritime brings a high level of authenticity and detail to the game that we’re thrilled to deliver to our players.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/7e856cce5f5fcf3c6792d9a2e9c1bfc32a34f6de.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]🛳️ What’s Next: Ferry Operations[/h3][p][/p][p]We’ve been hard at work behind the scenes on multiple fronts, including preparations for the upcoming public test of the[b] v0.8.3 update[/b], which brings [b]improvements[/b], [b]NPC crew tasks[/b], and [b]new features[/b].[/p][p]But we’re also thinking ahead — and one of the biggest features on the horizon is a brand-new class 4 of ships: [b]Ferries[/b].[/p][p]This isn’t just about adding a new vessel — it’s about adding a new [b]gameplay experience[/b]. Players can look forward to [b]ferry operations[/b], including:[/p][list][*][p]Transporting passengers[/p][/*][*][p]Loading and unloading vehicles[/p][/*][*][p]Hydraulic systems in action — like opening and closing the bow visor or stern ramp, all fully simulated[/p][/*][/list][p]If you’ve ever been on a real ferry, you know the feeling — the deep rumble of hydraulics, the clank of heavy metal, the moment the ramp drops. That’s the kind of immersion we’re aiming to bring to [i]Ships At Sea[/i]. These aren’t just ships — they’re living, working vessels, and every mechanical detail matters.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="4JqJP4Wi0O0;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][/p][h3]⚓ We Build with Purpose[/h3][p][/p][p]Our vision has always been about more than just adding ships. We aim to bring every vessel to life, with purpose, function, and character. Whether you’re navigating cargo routes or running scheduled ferry operations, we want you to feel like you’re part of something real.[/p][p]Update v0.8.3 is on the horizon, and development on future updates is already underway.[/p][p]Stay tuned — there’s much more coming, and we can’t wait to show you what’s next.[/p][p][/p][p]Smooth sailing,[/p][list][*][p]Team Misc Games [/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Redefining Interaction - A New Chapter with Update v0.8.3
notes.content: [p]Ahoy Sailors![/p][p]With [i]Ships At Sea[/i], we´re striving to deliver more than just realistic ships—we aim to create an immersive maritime environment where [i]everything[/i] feels accessible, interactable, purposeful, and believable. As part of that commitment, [b]Update v0.8.3[/b] marks a major milestone, starting with an [b]overhaul of the interaction system[/b].[/p][p]This isn't just a visual update—it's the foundation for smarter, more intuitive interaction across the entire game as we head toward larger, more complex ships and deeper gameplay systems.[/p][p][/p][h3]What's Changing?[/h3][p]The old interaction system served its purpose in the early stages of development. But as the game evolved, it became clear we needed more flexibility, clarity, and customizability. With v0.8.3, we’re introducing:[/p][p]✅ A Clearer Interface[/p][list][*][p]Each interaction now displays with a clean [b]background[/b], helping text and icons stand out against the environment.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Objective names[/b] are now clearly labelled, making it easier to understand what each interaction does at a glance.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Indicators[/b] provide instant feedback that something is interactable or working—whether it’s a switch, control panel, or cargo crane.[/p][/*][/list][p]⚙️ New Player Settings Planned[/p][list][*][p][b]Toggle options[/b] for backgrounds, objective names, indicators, and even highlighters—choose what you want visible.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Adjustable highlighter brightness[/b], perfect for players who prefer subtlety or those who want maximum visibility.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/f6a138d4032b4b3fd4abdf538b67bb7890727a6c.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/4812523ff17aaa3b1312de7a0e992f94f27c3e91.jpg"][/img][/carousel][h3]Why This Matters?[/h3][p]With larger ships already on the horizon and more detailed subsystems becoming standard, the interaction system needs to scale with the gameplay. Whether you're navigating a Tier 1 boat or operating complex equipment on a Tier 4 vessel, this new system ensures that [b]clarity never gets lost in complexity[/b].[/p][p]It's all part of our ongoing mission: to make [i]Ships At Sea[/i] not only authentic, but [i]playable, accessible, and enjoyable[/i]—whether you're a newcomer or a veteran mariner.[/p][p][/p][h3]Looking Ahead[/h3][p]The new interaction system is modular by design, allowing us to expand it further in upcoming updates. Expect even more interaction logic, visual improvements, and context-specific feedback as the game matures.[/p][p]This overhaul also lays the groundwork for [b]better gamepad support[/b]. While controller interaction will naturally differ slightly—especially in areas like the wheelhouse—the new system is designed with both keyboard/mouse and gamepad players in mind. Expect more intuitive and responsive controls as we continue to refine the experience across all input methods.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for sailing with us—and stay tuned for more as Update v0.8.3 docks soon![/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Team Misc Games[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1][/h1][p][/p]

notes.title: Spotlight on the Lighthouse Gameplay
notes.content: [p]Ayoi, Sailors![/p][p]Following the release of [b]Update v0.8.2[/b] to everyone, we’d like to take a moment to highlight one of the new gameplay elements: [b]The Lighthouse[/b] - [b]Beacon of the Sea[/b] [/p][p]Standing at its base, gazing up at one of the most iconic symbols of maritime navigation, a moment that’s both scenic and symbolic. These sea markers aren't just beautiful landmarks, they’re essential, and we’re excited to explore their gameplay potential even further.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/0d07557077f676f2aecde8cb17058b990c54bddf.png"][/img][/p][h3]Main Power Supply Unit[/h3][p]In this new system, both the lantern room and the interior lighting of the lighthouse are now fully integrated with a dedicated [b]Main Power Supply Unit[/b] located at the base of the structure. This enhancement adds a deeper level of realism and interactivity to the gameplay. As shown here, circuit breakers can be manually switched off—one controlling the interior lighting, and another dedicated to the lighthouse lens and its rotation. This setup gives players hands-on control over essential lighthouse functions, reinforcing the immersive simulation experience.[/p][p]Over time, key components—such as the light bulb positioned behind the Fresnel lens in the lantern room—can break randomly, and circuit breakers may overheat, triggering situations that require timely maintenance and repair from the player. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://media.giphy.com/media/r8tuFJ4vzoTMcP7HcL/giphy.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Voltage Gauge Indicator[/h3][p]Also, keep an eye on the [b]Volt gauge[/b] indicator, which tells you whether the lighthouse is receiving stable power. A significant voltage drop may signal a fault in the system, such as an overloaded circuit or a failing component, prompting further inspection and troubleshooting.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/163421dd14e21092a489778542aae9413c4f9b68.png"][/img][/p][h3]Main Power Switchboard- Indicator lights[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Green Light[/b] = Ok [/p][list][*][p]Everything is functioning normally. The switchgear and connected systems are working as expected without any issues.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Yellow Light[/b] = Needs Attention [/p][list][*][p]There may be a warning or minor issue, such as partial degradation or reduced performance. Maintenance may be needed soon.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Red Lights [/b]= Failure [/p][list][*][p]A critical failure has occurred. The switchgear or related systems are no longer functioning properly, and immediate attention or repair is required.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/40d1fc434c6c212e9b906c5fec70383ddd693e78.png"][/img][/p][h3]Fresnel Lens - Motorized Plate[/h3][p]One key example is the rotating lens, mounted on a motorized plate. Behind the Fresnel lens are the light bulbs that power the lighthouse beam. If a bulb breaks, players must first disable the rotation mechanism by flipping the appropriate circuit breaker before performing any repairs or replacing the bulb.[/p][p]To remove the broken light bulb, interact with the hinge to open the cover and take out the light bulb. Equip the new light bubble from your inventory and replace it. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/e477817cb2b82691ca501bd32597f698124bd8be.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Replacement light bulbs and circuit breakers can be purchased at the tool shop, so make sure to keep a few in stock![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/8bd8ad2f4b3d4483d9aaf83e0c40d5f89687aada.png"][/img][/p][p]Additionally, don’t forget to bring a drill—you’ll need it to unscrew the panel in order to remove the circuit breaker should it need replacement. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/ff4858ce4282e570aa1e4bbb995f93a78e4a6841.png"][/img][/p][p]As we move forward with [b]update v0.8.3[/b], we're excited to share that the lighthouse system will be integrated into our mission framework. This means [b]no missed jobs [/b]—whether tied to your company’s responsibilities or global events, all lighthouse-related tasks will now be properly tracked. And yes, you’ll [b]earn XP rewards[/b] for completing these vital duties. [/p][p]Additionally, we’re planning improvements to the beacon light and aiming for broader enhancements to lighting throughout the game to enhance the atmosphere. Stay tuned—there’s much more on the horizon![/p][p][/p][p]Fair Winds and Happy Sailing![/p][list][*][p]Team Misc Games[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Major Update v0.8.2 - Live Now!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Major Update v0.8.2 – Live Now![/b][/h2][p][/p][p]The seas are calling louder than ever—[b]Update v0.8.2[/b] is now officially live for all players! After a successful round of public testing, we’re thrilled to bring this feature-packed update into the main game.[/p][p]This major release introduces a range of immersive systems, including:[/p][list][*][p]A redesigned main menu with a new background, UI stages, and updated icons[/p][/*][*][p]Lighthouse repair and maintenance operations[/p][/*][*][p]Remote gear hauler support[/p][/*][*][p]Dynamic weather adjustments during gameplay sessions[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded keybinding customization[/p][/*][*][p]An overhauled XP and rewarding system[/p][/*][*][p]A reworked whale observation mission[/p][/*][*][p]Improved highlighters for interactable objects[/p][/*][/list][p]On top of that, we’ve implemented [b]numerous bug fixes, stability improvements[/b], and quality-of-life enhancements to make your maritime experience smoother and more engaging.[/p][p][/p][p][b]While Update v0.8.2 introduces the foundation for NPC crew management, there’s more to come.[/b][/p][p]Players can now hire crew members and assign them to Tier 3 fishing vessel at this moment—an essential first step toward deeper crew functionality in future updates![/p][p]However, the ability to assign specific tasks to your crew while out at sea will arrive in the next update, [b]v0.8.3[/b]. We're taking the time to refine and test this feature carefully, especially to ensure it performs reliably in multiplayer and under dynamic conditions.[/p][p]Thank you for your continued patience and support as we build out the full crew system, one step at a time![/p][p][/p][h2]Redesigned Main Menu, Background & UI Stages[/h2][p][/p][p][b]With Update v0.8.2, we're launching the next major phase of our UI overhaul—starting right from the main menu.[/b][/p][p]This update brings a fully redesigned main menu experience, featuring a refreshed background, cleaner layout, and a more intuitive structure. Core sections such as the Friends List, Settings, Profile Manager, Save Slots, and Load Game screen have all been revamped to improve clarity and usability from the moment you launch the game.[/p][p]We’ve also rolled out updated mission icons, making objectives easier to recognize and adding visual consistency across the board.[/p][p]As part of this update, we’re also ensuring the new UI is fully optimized for gamepad support, introducing a modernized set of keybinding icons, and adding adjustable controller vibration intensity settings—all in support of a smoother, more accessible experience for every type of player.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="_0P8PHMMVso;full"][/previewyoutube][p][img src="https://media.giphy.com/media/Dqd8LkjbPCpDqWnpiR/giphy.gif"][/img][/p][h3]New Certificate Card[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/438ad58d35859cfdf951d09ac620ea692b670fc1.png"][/img][/p][h2]Save Management Update[/h2][p][/p][p]The Load Game menu now features two dedicated tabs—one for Manual Saves and one for Auto-Saves—making it easier to organize, access, and manage your game progress at a glance.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/bdcb4d1b3767200c913dcd5f7d2bcb3941165048.png"][/img][/p][h2]Enhanced Controller Support & Vibration Settings[/h2][p][/p][p]This update continues our commitment to improving gamepad functionality by introducing a new setting for vibration intensity. Players can now adjust how strong or subtle the feedback feels, offering a more tailored and immersive experience.[/p][p]Currently, vibration is supported during the gutting fish mechanic, with more gameplay scenarios to follow in future updates.[/p][p]This is part of our broader effort to make Ships At Sea fully playable with a controller. As we roll out each phase of the UI overhaul, we’re also refining menu navigation and interactions to ensure they feel smooth and intuitive on gamepad.[/p][p]Expect further enhancements to controller support in the coming updates.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/4dfb8565f8a92d13fdf49f474a0b15774aec4c9d.png"][/img][/p][h2]New Customizable Unit System[/h2][p][/p][p]We also introduce a fully customizable unit system, giving players greater flexibility over how measurements are displayed in Ships At Sea.[/p][p]You can now choose from:[/p][list][*][p][b]Metric[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Imperial[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Nautical[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Custom[/b] – freely mix and match units to fit your own style[/p][/*][/list][p]Whether you prefer navigating in knots or hauling by pounds, you can now tailor the game’s measurements to match how you play.[/p][p]We’re also working to ensure all in-game instruments, HUD elements, and digital displays fully align with your selected unit mode. Full integration will continue in upcoming updates.[/p][p][img src="https://media.giphy.com/media/mQjwsIEPy7ibXrBOGF/giphy.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution – Now with FSR 4 Support[/h2][p][/p][p]We’ve upgraded our AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution support from FSR 3 to [b]FSR 3.1[/b], offering improved upscaling performance and enhanced image clarity for a smoother experience across a wider range of systems.[/p][p]We're also taking things further by adding [b]FSR 4 support[/b]. This next-generation version is handled entirely on the [b]driver side[/b] and is available exclusively for players using compatible AMD GPUs—such as the latest RDNA3-based graphics cards.[/p][p]If your system supports it, FSR 4 will be automatically detected and managed by your GPU driver. Players with supported hardware can choose to enable or disable FSR 4 through their driver settings. If preferred, you can fall back to the in-game FSR 3.1 for performance tuning that best suits your setup.[/p][p][b]Note:[/b] The following driver update from AMD will enable FSR 4 for Ships At Sea![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/0ce1c1f6c4f8b77212749732b0270bde1367d625.png"][/img][/p][h2]Take Control of the Weather – Now Live in Update v0.8.2[/h2][p][/p][p]You can now customize the weather in your current session—giving you full control over the environment. Whether you're battling rough seas, testing navigation tools in dense fog, or capturing dramatic in-game moments, the system puts the environment in your hands.[/p][p]🌦 [b]Accessing Weather Settings[/b]
Open your [b]Logbook[/b] and navigate to [b]Weather Settings[/b] to experiment with a range of sliders that adjust key conditions:[/p][list][*][p][b]Wave Height[/b] – Increase wind strength to generate rougher sea states[/p][/*][*][p][b]Snow[/b] – Drop the temperature below 0°C and add snowfall for wintry atmospheres[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rain[/b] – Adjust precipitation and surface wetness for rainy conditions[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fog[/b] – Lower visibility for a more challenging navigation scenario[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Time of Day Control[/b]
Weather changes don’t affect the in-game time. To change the time of day, use the [b]rest function[/b] at the clock gauge in the wheelhouse. Once time advances, weather settings remain fully customizable.[/p][p][b]What’s Next?[/b]
Further improvements to the weather settings, including enhancements to the weather system, are in development and will be introduced in future updates.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/825c3781bc82794f524e9d406e8ceafd2fdce616.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Crane Keybinding Customization Now Available[/h2][p][/p][p]Crane controls are now fully customizable—players can assign their preferred keys for a smoother, more intuitive experience. This is especially useful for those using alternative keyboard layouts, such as [b]AZERTY[/b].[/p][p]This marks the first step toward a broader overhaul of our input and interaction system. More keybinding options and deeper customization tools are already in development. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/7d100661f8d8937ba2c84edd2e882cd03ef8bcd5.png"][/img][/p][h2]HUD Update – Wind Direction & Weather Alignment[/h2][p][/p][p]To bring Ships At Sea closer to real-world maritime standards, we’ve refined how wind direction is represented and how it affects environmental elements in the game.[/p][p]The HUD’s wind direction arrow now accurately indicates the [b]source[/b] of the wind, just like real-world navigation instruments. This means if the arrow points north (0°), the wind is blowing [b]from[/b] the north, and environmental effects like waves, clouds, and rain will now move [b]southward[/b].[/p][p]This improvement not only enhances immersion but also ensures that weather behavior aligns with authentic nautical expectations, giving players a more intuitive and realistic experience at sea.[/p][p][/p][h2]Improved Save System[/h2][p][/p][p]We’ve upgraded the save system to ensure that all existing save files are automatically converted to the latest format. This change helps prevent specific crashes that could occur when a client joins a multiplayer session loaded from an older save. It’s part of our ongoing work to improve save file reliability and eliminate edge-case issues related to mission persistence.[/p][p]Furthermore, we added additional details to highlight older saves:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/5365e2ba1f91ebffb6ffa7ee6aae13e877162736.png"][/img][/p][h2]Lighthouse Repair & Maintenance – New Gameplay Arrives[/h2][p][/p][p]A brand-new hands-on activity has been introduced with Update v0.8.2: [b]Lighthouse Repair & Maintenance[/b].[/p][p]Players can now step inside the lighthouse and take responsibility for keeping it operational. You’ll be tasked with maintaining key systems like the [b]lantern room[/b] and [b]main power supply[/b], which ensure both the beacon and interior lights stay functional. This feature brings new interactivity and purpose to coastal landmarks, adding to the game’s realism and depth.[/p][p]🛠 While the core mechanics are already implemented, the full mission structure for lighthouse upkeep will be introduced in upcoming updates, so stay tuned as we continue to expand this gameplay![/p][p][img src="https://media.giphy.com/media/ZDS1pLfjLqaNdyeZER/giphy.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/e477817cb2b82691ca501bd32597f698124bd8be.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/0d07557077f676f2aecde8cb17058b990c54bddf.png"][/img][/p][h2]Main Power Switchboard - Full Electrical Integration Now Live[/h2][p][/p][p]All onboard instruments and equipment are now fully wired into the remaining circuit breakers on the main power switchboard, located in your ship’s technical room. This includes key systems like the [b]radar[/b], [b]sonar, crane[/b], and other powered tools, making them part of the ship’s unified electrical infrastructure.[/p][p]If any system unexpectedly shuts down, don’t worry: head to the switchboard and check the circuit breakers. This should now be your go-to troubleshooting step, reinforcing the immersive, hands-on ship management experience at the heart of [i]Ships At Sea[/i].[/p][p][/p][quote][p][b]Note:[/b] Additional improvements, such as visual effects and sound cues when a circuit breaker trips, are planned for an upcoming update.[/p][/quote][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/c8995502e66fb2e950286fbea1351d84b3f84781.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Mission Reward System Overhaul[/h2][p][/p][p]With Update v0.8.2, we’ve completely reworked the mission rewarding system to move beyond the previous flat model that rewarded players solely based on travel distance.[/p][p]This new system introduces a dynamic, effort-based structure that recognizes meaningful contributions during missions. Rewards are now influenced by:[/p][list][*][p][b]Individual participation and proportional effort[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Cargo condition upon delivery[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Mission completion speed[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]This redesign offers a more immersive and fair progression system that better reflects player performance and teamwork. It also lays essential groundwork for balanced reward distribution in co-op company play, ensuring that every team member is compensated in proportion to their actions and impact.[/p][p]Expect further tuning and mission-specific balancing in future patches as we expand the system to new mission types.[/p][quote][p][b]Note:[/b] The mission completion widget currently does not display the updated XP and rewards structure. A full breakdown of achievements, XP gains, and payouts will be introduced in a future update for a more satisfying post-mission summary.[/p][/quote][p][/p][h2]XP System Reworked for Fair Co-op Progression[/h2][p][/p][p]We’ve reworked the [b]core XP distribution system[/b] to create a more balanced, rewarding, and team-driven experience, especially in co-op play. The new system features [b]smart XP sharing[/b], designed to reflect both individual effort and collaborative success across a wide range of gameplay activities.[/p][p]Our Goals:[/p][list][*][p]Provide fair XP rewards[/p][/*][*][p]Ensure all players in a [b]co-op company[/b] gain meaningful progression, regardless of whether they focus on [b]fishing[/b], [b]cargo[/b], or [b]service[/b] tasks.[/p][/*][*][p]Support long-term engagement by making [b]teamwork and task diversity[/b] feel equally valuable.[/p][/*][/list][quote][p]More XP is distributed across the game, and additional fine-tuning will continue in future updates as we expand the system to cover even more gameplay scenarios, mission types and co-op play![/p][/quote][p][/p][p][b]Where further XP is now earned:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Casting and hauling nets, XP increase in rough weather[/p][/*][*][p]Gutting fish, with XP scaling based on fish size[/p][/*][*][p]Manual fish sorting[/p][/*][*][p]Untangling fish caught in nets[/p][/*][*][p]Travel distance—but also XP is awarded to all crew members aboard the vessel[/p][/*][*][p]Repairing overheated circuit breakers or fuses[/p][/*][*][p]Setting or hauling fishing gear[/p][/*][*][p]Baiting longlines, and so on...[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]New: Interactable Object Highlighting[/h2][p][/p][p]To improve player guidance and make interactions more intuitive, we've introduced a visual highlighting system for interactable objects. This feature helps players quickly spot usable items or controls in the environment, reducing confusion, especially when learning new systems or exploring complex vessels.[/p][p]As ship systems become more advanced and detailed, precise interaction becomes even more important. This new system will continue to evolve, with future refinements focusing on specific buttons, levers, and control points to ensure you always know exactly where to interact.[/p][p]Highlighting will also be paired with tooltips and other visual cues in upcoming updates, making gameplay actions more accessible and easy to understand at a glance.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://media.giphy.com/media/VeJnfpvz1xGrSYmRV3/giphy.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Gear Remote Control – New Upgrade Now Available[/h2][p][/p][p]The Gear Remote Control is now fully implemented as a dedicated boat upgrade. Players can purchase and install the Gear Remote Control via the [b]Shipyard Upgrade[/b] menu. Once equipped, this upgrade allows you to remotely initiate both [b]longline[/b] and [b]net hauling [/b]via the[b] N-hint key[/b]. [/p][p]Physical interaction with the gear remote controller device is [b]not yet supported[/b]—the feature currently functions via key input only. Further improvements and interactivity are planned in future updates.[/p][quote][p][b]Important Note for Net Fishing:[/b][/p][p]To use the Gear Remote Control for net hauling, you must first mount the hauler and close the hatch. Once activated the remote control from the wheelhouse, the player will be automatically teleported behind the processing table, where the untangling fish mechanic begins. [/p][/quote][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/16517e104b372884ed0383e9c86908665db11de5.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/a7f84070e4fbb4358ad275ad7db58a1ad0d5f0f4.png"][/img][/p][h2]Mission-Specific Cargo Tracking ID Now Implemented[/h2][p][/p][p]Managing multiple deliveries is now more intuitive. In response to community feedback, we’ve resolved the confusion that arose when delivering cargo tied to different missions at the same destination. Previously, players could unintentionally drop off items unrelated to an active mission—resulting in lost XP and unclear outcomes.[/p][p]With Update v0.8.2, all mission cargo now includes a clear [b]tracking ID[/b], showing exactly which mission it belongs to and whether that mission is currently active. This makes it easier to manage multiple objectives and ensures that every delivery counts.[/p][p][/p][h2]Icon Overhaul for Shop & Inventory[/h2][p][/p][p]To improve visual consistency and item recognition, we've begun replacing all icons in the shop and inventory with in-game renderings of the actual items. This ensures that what players see in the UI directly reflects what they interact with in the world, creating a more immersive gameplay experience. Additional icons—such as for gutted and ungutted fish—will follow to a later point![/p][p]Looking ahead, update [b]v0.8.3[/b] will introduce a redesigned inventory systems, an overhauled logbook with organized tabs, and an improved mission progression window to streamline gameplay management further.[/p][h2]Upgradable Knives Now Available at the Tool Shop[/h2][p][/p][p]A new layer of progression has arrived—players can now purchase and equip upgradable knives from the tool shop to boost their gutting performance. Each knife tier offers increased precision and speed, enabling you to handle fish more efficiently and enhance your overall processing flow.[/p][p]This is just the first step in a broader upgrade system. Future updates will introduce more upgradeable tools or ship-related systems, giving you greater control over how you refine your workflow and optimize operations at sea.[/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/e03cee832f9307d0ad1a7497c467e37cc89dde01.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/2e9abcda01011e3f05ca3625987a9bd7979e02ad.png"][/img][/carousel][h2]Master Bigger Catches with Upgradable Hooks[/h2][p][/p][p]Upgradable hooks are now available to enhance your longline fishing experience. Higher-tier hooks allow you to secure larger catches and handle longline gear with greater efficiency and reliability.[/p][p]This is part of our broader upgrade system, which will continue to expand in future updates. Players can look forward to more ways to improve their gear and vessel performance, offering deeper progression and customization across all career paths.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/53274b8acd54298a83d40b40983033a399596642.png"][/img][/p][h2]Whale Observation Mission Returns[/h2][p][/p][p]The whale observation mission has been reworked with smoother gameplay and greater immersion. Head out to sea, explore the waters, and witness unforgettable encounters with these majestic creatures.[/p][p]And don’t forget your binoculars—you won’t want to miss a moment.

notes.title: Public Test Update v0.8.2.1374 - Incoming Patch!
notes.content: [h2]Patch Release – Public Test Update v0.8.2 Continues to Evolve![/h2][p][/p][p]Ahoy Sailors![/p][p]As part of our ongoing commitment to improving [b]Ships At Sea[/b], this latest patch for [b]Update v0.8.2 [/b]delivers key improvements and fixes based on feedback from the Public Test. As development continues across major systems, including the NPC crew feature, weather tools, UI overhaul, missions, and XP and reward system, this patch focuses on refining the experience introduced in the initial update and adds a new feature - [b]Gear Remote Control Hauler![/b][/p][p][/p][h3]Gear Remote Control – New Upgrade Available[/h3][p][/p][p]The [b]Gear Remote Control[/b] is now fully implemented as a dedicated boat upgrade. Previously released as a standalone feature, it has now been integrated with an actual item that appears in your wheelhouse once installed.[/p][p]Players can purchase and install the [b]Gear Remote Control[/b] via the [b]Shipyard Upgrade menu[/b]. Once equipped, this device allows anyone who works on the ship to initiate longline and net hauling remotely, giving you more flexibility and control without needing to stand directly at the gear hauler.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/16517e104b372884ed0383e9c86908665db11de5.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/a7f84070e4fbb4358ad275ad7db58a1ad0d5f0f4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Improved Mission Save System [/h3][p][/p][p]We’ve upgraded the mission save system to ensure that all existing save files are automatically converted to the latest format. This change helps prevent specific crashes that could occur when a client joins a multiplayer session loaded from an older save. It’s part of our ongoing work to improve save file reliability and eliminate edge-case issues related to mission persistence. [/p][p][/p][p]Furthermore, we added additional details to highlight older saves: [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/5365e2ba1f91ebffb6ffa7ee6aae13e877162736.png"][/img][/p][h3]HUD - Weather and Wind Direction Alignment[/h3][p][/p][p]To better reflect real-world meteorological behavior, we've improved how wind direction interacts with environmental effects. The wind indicator [b]arrow in the HUD[/b] now shows the direction [i]from which[/i] the wind is blowing, just like in real navigation instruments. As a result, weather elements such as waves, clouds, and rain will now move in the [b]opposite direction[/b] of the arrow. For instance, if the arrow points north (0°), it means the wind is coming from the north, and weather effects will move from north to south. This adjustment enhances immersion and aligns Ships at Sea's weather system more closely with maritime realism.[/p][p][/p][h3][/h3][h3]Custom Crane Keybindings Added[/h3][p][/p][p]We’ve added customizable keybindings for crane controls, allowing players to assign their preferred keys for smoother operation. This is especially helpful for players using alternate keyboard layouts such as AZERTY. Please note that this is the first step toward broader input customization. Additional keybinding options and improvements to the overall input and interaction system are planned for Update v0.8.3.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/7d100661f8d8937ba2c84edd2e882cd03ef8bcd5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Update 0.8.2 – Patch Notes[/h3][p][/p][p][b]New Features & Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added on the Conquest and Fixer vessels for improved capacity [/p][/*][*][p]Reworked cargo delivery locations at Kveldsbeita, Lyngvær, and Kårøya to prevent boats from getting stuck at the pier when loading a save game[/p][/*][*][p]Refactored remote hauling to function as a purchasable boat upgrade via the Shipyard upgrade menu[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected a mismatch between the wave direction and the wind direction indicator on the HUD to ensure visual alignment with weather data[/p][/*][*][p][b]Disabled the "Start Storm" button[/b] temporarily in the Weather Settings due to functionality issues (will be addressed in a future patch)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a crash related to loading ports[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash related to fish hook mechanics[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a
