notes.title: Public Test v0.8 – The Long-Awaited Tier 3 Ships and Major Overhaul!
notes.content:
Ahoy Captains, 

Public Test for v0.8.1132 is here, bringing the highly anticipated Tier 3 ships along with a massive overhaul of the game’s core systems. To provide a more optimized and immersive experience, we undertook an extensive refactoring of the entire game—a crucial step to improve stability, address key player-reported issues, and enhance performance.

This refactoring also lays the foundation for future expansions, ensuring that [b]Ships At Sea[/b] remains a long-term, evolving project with new features, content, and gameplay mechanics to come. By strengthening the core systems now, we are setting the stage for an even deeper and more engaging maritime experience in the future. However, due to the extensive scope of the refactoring, this version of v0.8 does not yet include all the planned features.

While you are testing and providing us valuable feedback, we will continue working on improvements and completing the remaining planned features for v0.8 through monthly patches! We didn’t want to keep you waiting any longer, so we’re releasing this update now, with more content and refinements to follow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/5b5ee6bcef77657946d20d730d71958d57453a22.png[/img]

[h2]Backup Your Savegame[/h2]
To avoid any potential issues, we strongly recommend that you back up your save files before switching to the [b]Public Test version v0.8[/b]. Save games from version 0.7.5 should automatically upgrade when you load them. However, there may be some edge cases. Please let us know if you experience any problems while loading your save game from version 0.7.5!

[quote=author][b]To find your Steam for Ships At Sea saves:[/b]
[list]
[*] Press Win + E
[*] Paste %USERPROFILE%\AppData\Local\Sas\Saved\SaveGames into the search bar.
[/list]
[b]To try the PUBLIC TEST, please follow these steps:[/b]
[list]
[*] Open Steam
[*] Right-click on Ships At Sea in your library
[*] Select Properties
[*] Go to the Betas tab
[*] Enter the password: SaSPublicTest
[*] Choose "public_test" from the "Beta participation" drop-down list
[*] Wait for the game to update the files (if nothing happens, restart the Steam client)
[*] Launch the game
[/list][/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/30c117a9a330a9df355b8855e8bc3e06b621f2bd.png[/img]

[h2]What’s New & Ready to Test?[/h2]

This update brings major graphical and lighting enhancements, improved weather effects, upgraded AMD FSR 3.1, and support for five languages. Additionally, it features a fully reworked cargo and mission system, an overhauled savegame system, and a refined inventory system, delivering a smoother, more immersive, and polished gameplay experience.

Here’s what you can explore and test right now in v0.8:
[list]
[*] 5 Supported Languages – French, German, Italian, Norwegian, Russian, and Spanish.
[*] All Tier 3 Ships Available – Unlock cargo, service, and fishing vessels from the shipyard.
[*] Tier 2 Crane – Equipped on the cargo ship, with the option to upgrade to a second crane.
[*] Fully Completed Interiors – Including the wheelhouse, cabins, and technical rooms. Some rooms remain empty for additional features coming in future updates.
[*] New and Improved Cargo & Mission System – Completely reworked for better gameplay flow.
[*] Longline Fishing & Fish Production Line – Now implemented on the Tier 3 fishing ship.
[*] Improved Longline & Net Fishing Mechanics – Enhancements for a more refined experience.
[*] New Autopilot System with Three Distinct Modes:
- STBY Mode: Autopilot is on but allows free steering
- AUTO Mode: Maintains direction automatically without a plotted route
- NAV Mode: Follows a plotted route. The map now features two types of markers:
-- Player Markers: Allow free route planning.
-- Autopilot Path Markers: Show the current route the autopilot is following.
[*] Radar Overhaul – Now supports EBL (Electronic Bearing Line), providing a second line alongside the heading line, allowing players to measure the bearing to specific targets or locations relative to the ship's position.
[*] New Lighthouse Docking Location – Players can now dock and enter at the lighthouse. (Work in progress – more exciting features to come.)
[*] New Searchlight System – Players can switch between multiple searchlights and control them independently via the searchlight control panel in the wheelhouse.
[/list]
[h2]Missions[/h2]
Your first mission are now automatically activated when accepted. You can manage active missions in your logbook under Company -> Missions. All missions are now tracked, and you'll receive both money and XP upon delivery. Currently, only cargo missions are available at ports. Additional mission types, including burning boats, towing, and trash collection, will be introduced in a future update.

[h2]Upcoming Improvements[/h2]

Future v0.8 updates will introduce several new features, including: 

We have additional wheelhouse improvements planned for future patches. The steering wheel on Tier 3 cargo and service ships will be replaced with a steering joystick, and navigation screens will be optimized for better usability. Camera zoom on instruments will also be improved, and the interaction system will be overhauled to provide a better experience when interacting with controls. Thrusters will also be introduced for Tier 3 ships to enhance manoeuvrability. Additionally, we are completely reworking the UI, both visually and functionally. The new HUD is already in place, and further UI enhancements across all areas will be rolled out in stages.

notes.title: Introducing Fish Production Line on Tier 3 Fishing Ship!
notes.content:
Greetings, Seafarers!

We are excited to unveil a significant new feature coming to Ships At Sea with Tier 3 fishing ship: the [b]Fish Production Line![/b] This system adds an authentic and immersive approach to processing fish, giving players a deeper connection to the operational aspects of commercial fishing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/cf28d62cada9410763fdf80344c3f9209b07ec41.jpg[/img]

[h2]How It Works[/h2]
Fresh caught and ungutted fish will be transported from the bleeding box on the work deck to the production line. Using a conveyor system, as you can see above, the fish will move through the processing area, where players can interact with the gutting stations.

[h3]Longline Hauler[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/aadd05240fa7f823afce7218ae6f157601def37b.jpg[/img]
[h3]Bleeding Box[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/a4d83d664b01ae4d5634c7fd137d15a29c3dfe69.jpg[/img]

[h3]At the gutting station, players can:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Pick up fish from the conveyor belt:[/b] Position yourself at the gutting table to retrieve fish for processing.
[*] [b]Gutting Station:[/b] Use a knife to gut the fish.
[*] [b]Return to the Conveyor Belt:[/b] Once gutted, the fish is placed back on the top conveyor belt, where it is transported to the storage room. The storage room allows players to organize and store gutted fish in boxes, ensuring a streamlined and organized workflow.
[/list]
[h3]Interactive Controls:[/h3]
You, as a player, will have control over the flow of the production line.
[list]
[*] A [b]start/stop button[/b] will allow you to open or close a hatch, controlling how much fresh fish spawns on the conveyor belt. When the bleeding box is empty, the gutting process will be complete.
[/list]
[h2]Future Plans[/h2]
We plan to expand, such as introducing upgrades for the gutting stations and allowing players to install automated gutting machines. These machines will streamline the process further—players will feed in fresh fish, and gutted fish will emerge on the other end, ready for storage.

[h2]A Step Toward Excellence[/h2]
This is just the beginning of the production line system in Ships At Sea. Our goal is to create the most immersive maritime experience, and this feature is a step toward making Ships At Sea the best of its kind.

We understand that many of you are eagerly awaiting the next update, version 0.8. We want to assure you that we are diligently working to address the issues you’ve reported while also developing exciting new features. We appreciate your feedback on this development news and look forward to sharing more updates as we continue to enhance the gameplay experience.

Stay the course!

- Team Misc Games

notes.title: Introducing 360-Degree View for Crane Operations
notes.content:
Ahoy, Captains!

We’re excited to share an exciting new feature coming to [b]Ships At Sea[/b]—our crane operations are levelling up with an additional [b]360-degree camera view[/b]!

Gone are the days of dealing with blind spots while operating cranes. This new feature allows you to freely switch camera perspectives, giving you complete visibility and precision when using the crane. Whether you´re loading or unloading cargo, you’ll have the perfect view every time.

[img]https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExaWl6dWZ3bnN0cm8wNTBsZWJ6ZDJqbTVpejUxenQ2MmM4MWkyZmdibyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/OAOgPRmyeQ7YsPWPdz/giphy.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExdW9pYmJoOGJ0M2RnaTFnamIxbnExaTBzZjBsb21mdXd3a2JiYWs4MSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/LqLdbcxbe7XpIfyvA6/giphy.gif[/img]

But that’s not all—this enhancement isn’t limited to just one type of crane. The 360-degree view will scale with all supported cranes in the future, including the upcoming Tier 2 crane, which is part of our next [b]v0.8 update[/b].  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/0cb4268c3ac34de10d2889c25b68b3cc1f820c5f.png[/img]

With larger Tier 3 ships on the way and new gameplay elements in development, we’re working hard to make every feature more immersive. There’s a lot to look forward to in the upcoming update!

We’re also putting a spotlight on improving existing features, thanks to your invaluable feedback through our in-game reporting system, Discord, and Steam discussions. Here’s what we’re refining:

[list]
[*] [b]Mission System:[/b] Enhancing cargo tracking and counting, making it more dynamic, flexible, and prepared for immersive missions.
[*] [b]Savegame System:[/b] Optimizing it for a smoother, more seamless experience for all players.
[/list]

And that’s just the beginning—there’s so much more to come! Stay tuned, and we’ll keep you updated with all the exciting developments for update v0.8. 

Fair winds and smooth seas, 

Team Misc Games

notes.title: Update v0.7.5 - Live Now!
notes.content:
Ahoy, Captains!

We’re excited to announce that [b]Update v0.7.5[/b] is now live in [b]Ships At Sea[/b]! This major update brings a wave of improvements, new features, and fixes to enhance your maritime adventure. Whether you’re exploring the open seas solo or in co-op, there’s plenty to discover. 

[h2]Highlights of v0.7.5:[/h2]

[h3]Set Sail Together: The Co-op Feature Has Arrived![/h3]
Team up with your friends to navigate the seas, take on missions, and collaborate on various tasks. In addition to the cooperative gameplay, each player can command and manage their own vessel in Ships At Sea, introducing a unique element of strategy and teamwork to your maritime adventures!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/219e00d8a5b970527c2927e04dcdfab4c82d791f.png[/img]

[h3]Build Your Legacy with the Company Feature[/h3]
Players can collaborate in a team to run a company or operate independently to compete with others in the same session.

[h3]Redefining Logistics with the Overhauled Cargo System[/h3]
Efficient cargo placement and stacking are essential for establishing a foundation for large cargo vessels and container ships.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/781f6673282cd1c232c283062e9ea41b77185a08.png[/img]

[h3]Experience More Flexibility with the Improved Mission System[/h3]
Experience a more dynamic and immersive gameplay with randomized pickup and delivery locations uniquely tailored to each cargo mission. Future updates will extend this feature to additional mission types, offering even greater variety and excitement!

[h3]Customize Your Experience with Wave Size Adjustment[/h3]
To enhance player control and immersion, we’ve refined how wave sizes can be adjusted based on varying weather conditions. The game features two primary weather systems: [b]Normal Weather[/b] and [b]Storm Weather[/b]. 

You can fine-tune wave intensity by adjusting its percentage, allowing you to simulate a variety of sea conditions. Ships At Sea uses the Beaufort Scale, a real-world empirical measure that connects wind speed to sea states. Here’s how it corresponds to our simulation:
[list]
[*]25% = Beaufort scale 1 - 3
[*]50% = Beaufort scale 1 - 6
[*]75% = Beaufort scale 1 - 8
[*]100% = Beaufort scale 1 - 12
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/faf913c52d6d7d390eaf6ca6f9a99c0d7954beff.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/eaed178cd478992a4891866e2db8f339b6834dde.png[/img]

It’s important to note that not every rainy or snowy day in Ships At Sea is classified as a storm—some may feature precipitation without heavy winds or rough seas. By adjusting wave sizes, you can fine-tune these conditions to create a more personalized experience. Keep in mind that wave settings apply only to the current session and cannot be modified once the session begins.

[h3]Enhance Your Fishing with the Advanced Sonar System[/h3]
We are excited to introduce the debut of multiple sonar modes in Ships At Sea! This new system enhances your maritime experience by providing greater depth and realism. With improved tools for locating and identifying fish, your fishing expeditions are now more immersive and authentic than ever before. Dive in and explore the possibilities!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/19724ef40e55edcb686138b10923cc8947977ba5.png[/img]

[h3]Master Your Navigation with the Radar System[/h3]
Radar is an essential tool for maritime navigation. It enables the detection of nearby ships and land obstacles while providing vital information about the distance and direction of other objects. This is critical for collision avoidance, whether at sea or near the shore. With radar, captains can confidently navigate through low-visibility conditions, such as darkness or adverse weather, ensuring a safe and steady course.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/219c71db2f51cec4a65b3b9fac90827706571e2c.png[/img]

Our radar system comes packed with configurable features designed to enhance your navigation experience. Adjustable sensitivity, sea and weather clutter suppression, and measuring distance and bearing ensure your route remains clear and accurate. You can track the position of your vessel, monitor nearby ships, and utilize NAV lines and markers to stay on course. Additionally, the radar supports Relative Motion (RM) and True Motion (TM) modes, providing greater control and situational awareness of the open water.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/ce01de98b7b6a77bd0d85387d36331ca04dff6e3.png[/img]

[h3]Sail to the Rhythm with Our Improved Radio System[/h3]

Enhance your maritime adventures with Ships At Sea's new radio feature! Now, you can listen to your favorite tracks or online radio stations directly from your boat's cockpit. Whether you are navigating calm waters or facing stormy seas, let the music elevate your journey.

[b]Control the Radio:[/b]
[list]
[*]Switch Sources: Seamlessly toggle between in-game music and online radio channels with the source button.
[*]Audio Management: Turn the music on or off, adjust the volume, skip tracks or channels, and even loop your favorite tunes.
[*]Save Favorites: Use the mode button to save up to 6 favorite radio channels for quick and easy access.
[/list]
[b]Custom Radio Options:[/b]
Want to personalize your soundtrack? Add custom radio channels directly in the Settings menu:
[list]
[*]Enter the URL of your desired radio channel
[*]Supported formats include mp3, aac-lc, he-aac v1, and he-aac v2
[/list]
[b]Enjoy Preset Channels:[/b]
We’ve also included several online radio stations ready for you to dive into. 
[list]
[*]Simulator Radio
[*]Truck Stop
[*]Simulator FM
[*]Simulator Vibe 
[*]Simulator Hits
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/6699829d11896013ac2f2abe96173d794d483fac.png[/img]

[h3]Access to v0.7.2[/h3]
For those who prefer to continue their current game progress, we created a separate branch for version v0.7.2. Please be aware that this branch will not receive future updates. To take advantage of the new features and improvements in the future, transitioning to [b]v0.7.5 [/b]will be required.

[h3]Savegames[/h3]
Ships At Sea is currently in Early Access, and with the release of Update v0.7.5, significant changes have been made to the game’s core architecture. As a result, savefiles from version v0.7.2 are not compatible with the new update, meaning players will need to start a new game.

Additionally, please note that cargo-saving functionality is not yet available. The cargo and mission systems have undergone a complete rework to improve gameplay, and while we’ve made substantial progress, certain features are still in development. We are actively working to enable cargo-saving soon and appreciate your patience as we continue to refine the game.

notes.title: Public Test Open Now - Update v0.7.5
notes.content:
Dear fellow Captains!

We’re excited to announce that Update v0.7.5 is now available for public testing! This update includes significant architectural improvements, particularly to support co-op/competitive mode, new features for creating and inviting players to the companies, and a completely reworked cargo and mission system. 

[h1]Key Information[/h1]
[list]
[code][b]This version is currently in an experimental stage, so you may experience instability, unoptimized performance, and potential game-breaking bugs. We will be updating this branch frequently to address issues. However, please note that any progress or saved games may be reset once the testing period concludes.

This is a unique opportunity to help us identify bugs and gain early insights into the development of our next update.

We kindly ask that you refrain from leaving negative reviews based on this testing branch. Your understanding and support are greatly appreciated.[/b]❤️[/code]
[/list]
To access the [b]Public Test[/b] branch:
[list]
[*] Right-click Ships At Sea on the Steam-Library
[*] Select Properties
[*] Select Betas
[*] Enter Password and click [b]Check Code[/b]
[*] From the dropdown menu, choose "Public Test"
[/list]
Use [b]password[/b]: [code]SaSPublicTest[/code]  

[*][b]Savefile Compatibility[/b] 
Please note that Ships At Sea is an Early Access game. Due to the extensive changes made to the game’s architecture, savefiles from version v0.7.2 will not be compatible with Update v0.7.5. This means players will need to start a new game and create a new profile with a company. 

Also, keep in mind that [b]saving cargo is currently not possible[/b]. The cargo and mission system has undergone a complete rework, and while significant progress has been made, certain tasks still need to be completed before cargo-saving functionality can be fully supported. We appreciate your understanding as we work towards enabling this feature soon.

[*][b]Access to v0.7.2[/b] 
You won’t need to delete your existing saved files. For those who prefer to continue their current game progress, we will move version v0.7.2 to a separate branch once Update v0.7.5 has completed public testing and is ready for full release. Please be aware that this branch will not receive future updates or support. To take advantage of the new features and improvements in the future, transitioning to [b]v0.7.5 [/b]will be required.

[*][b]Feedback and Bug Reporting[/b] 
We've added a new section in the Main Menu - [b]Quick Feedback[/b] where you can report bugs directly from within the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/f938a7d27d19ed09c3b90211eaf41e6d1bb35f8e.png[/img]

To help us resolve issues effectively, please include detailed steps of what you did before encountering the bug or crash, specify which boat you were using, and indicate whether it occurred in single-player mode or multiplayer as a host or client. Please check the box for [b]Attach log file[/b] to send us a report of your current game session and hardware details. Don't worry—no personal data will be shared!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/9ab9f36beb47bafcb525b221002c61c06a307a0b.png[/img]

[h1]Player Profile[/h1]
In Update v0.7.5, we’ve integrated a player profile system, making it easier than ever to get started with single or multiplayer sessions. Here’s how to create and manage your player profile and create or join multiplayer sessions.  
[list]
[*] [b]Creating a Player Profile[/b]
After starting a new game, players can create and customize a profile. This profile will save their progress, including level, boat certificate, and experiences.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/05f7e9afabf6b4497c34a721100182ed62924c9b.png[/img]
[*][b]Creating a Game[/b] 
To create a single or multiplayer session, select [b]Create Game[/b]. To join an existing multiplayer session, select [b]Join Game[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/4b6837a003cb94fa5a23fc337ed70e64e9e7ee26.png[/img]

[*][b]Enabling Single or Multiplayer Session[/b] 
To play in single-player mode, [u]uncheck the Multiplayer option[/u] and select [b]Create New Game[/b]. To create a multiplayer session, ensure the [u]Multiplayer option is checked[/u]. This will allow you to set up a session and invite up to three other players to join your session. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/be65db8c88393482445003af8237bcd50ea01eca.png[/img]

[*][b]Wave Size Adjustment[/b] 
To provide a more dynamic and customizable experience, we’ve expanded how players can adjust wave sizes based on different weather conditions. It’s important to know that the game features two main types of weather systems: [b]Normal Weather [/b]and [b]Storm Weather[/b]. Not all rainy or snowy days are classified as storms, some may involve precipitation without heavy winds or rough seas. Adjusting wave sizes allows you to customize these conditions for added realism and control. Please keep in mind that these wave settings apply specifically to that session and cannot be changed once the session has begun.

[b]Wave Height: [/b]You can adjust the percentage for overall wave intensity to simulate various sea conditions. In [i]Ships At Sea[/i], we use the [b]Beaufort Scale[/b], a real-world, empirical measure that relates wind speed to observed sea conditions. Here´s how the scale applies to our water simulation: 

[*]25% = Beaufort scale 1 - 3
[*]50% = Beaufort scale 1 - 6
[*]75% = Beaufort scale 1 - 8
[*]100% = Beaufort scale 1 - 12
[/list]
[b]Note:[/b] The Tutorial is currently disabled in the Public Test version!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/faf913c52d6d7d390eaf6ca6f9a99c0d7954beff.png[/img]

[h1]Company Feature[/h1]
With Update v0.7.5, we are introducing the long-awaited company feature to add depth to both single and multiplayer gameplay, whether in co-op or competitive play. Here’s how it works:
[list]
[*][b]Company Creation[/b]
As soon as a player starts a new game or joins a session, whether it is single-player or multiplayer, they automatically create a company. Each player begins with an initial capital of 50,000 NOK, which they can use to build and expand their company. When players join a company together, their starting capitals are combined into a single pool.
[*][b]Building Your Own Company[/b]
Players can work independently to grow their company, complete missions, and compete with others in the same session to become the top maritime enterprise.
[*][b]Co-op Mode[/b]
One of the standout features of [i]Ships At Sea[/i] as a maritime simulation game is the flexibility it offers in cooperative play. Team members can choose to work on their own desired vessel, complete tasks and missions individually, or collaborate by working together on the same vessel. Please keep in mind to enter a co-worker's boat, you need to be part of the same company. This approach allows players to share responsibilities, resources, items and capital, fostering a sense of teamwork in an immersive setting. As a result, each gaming session becomes dynamic and engaging.
[/list]
[h3]To team up with others, invite friends to join your company: [/h3]
[list]
[*]Open the [b]Company Manager[/b] by selecting TAB-key
[*]Select [b]Invite Employee[/b]
[*]Choose from the list of available players in the session who can accept your invitation and join your company.
[*]Furthermore, you can rename or switch companies during a session. Simply select [b]Switch Company[/b] to join an alternative company or create your own.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/09cf389f165793a7e6a5be9624d543a16c3c38f1.png[/img]

To view your company's mission status, open the Company Manager and navigate to the [b]Missions[/b] tab. Here, you'll find a comprehensive list showing all missions your team has taken on, including active missions and completed tasks. This makes it easy to track progress and stay organized within your company: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/c219c9910b01172d714ce9a685406dce86168d2d.png[/img]

To share items from your [b]Player Inventory[/b] with your team members in the company, select the item and transfer it to the [b]Company Inventory[/b]. It’s an easy way to pool resources and support your team:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/d8bef0d04bd56f6582b33a5e1fbfb09758c3f5c1.png[/img]

The co-op, competitive, and company features will continue to evolve as [i]Ships At Sea[/i] progresses. As players unlock larger ships, they will gain access to more complex tasks and missions, presenting new challenges and opportunities for both solo players in single-player mode and teams in multiplayer. We also plan to introduce NPC coworkers to assist you with completing tasks, adding a new level of strategy for all players.

[h1]New Cargo and Mission System[/h1]
We are reworking and expanding the cargo system to establish a strong foundation for future gameplay. These updates will make efficient cargo placement and stacking essential not only for larger cargo vessels in general but also specifically for container ships. This overhaul is crucial as we aim to improve cargo capabilities, ensuring that strategic placement, stacking, and organization of a variety of items can meet the demands of larger vessels. 

The mission system has also received a major overhaul to provide a more flexible and engaging experience. A new centralized mission manager now simplifies the addition and management of different mission types across the game. Currently, this makes cargo missions more dynamic, with randomized pickup and delivery locations based on specific tags. This enhancement will allow for more varied and immersive missions and enrich gameplay for future mission types and updates.

[img]https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExb3pkYjVrc2syOHczOTBzd2txeWZ4MGVrMzA1MmY2Y3BqaXR4cmtxdCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/bz4LctfS03dlWG8TPH/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]

While we've always had various cargo sizes, the new system introduces a block-based approach where each cargo item occupies a specific number of blocks in the boat's cargo hold. For example, an XS item takes up just one block, while an XL item can require up to 16 blocks. This updated system adds an engaging challenge: smaller cargo items allow for greater quantities, enabling multiple missions in one trip, whereas larger items require more space. The loading and stacking capacity also varies by boat size and class, adding a new layer of strategy to cargo management. A green highlighter shows a compatible placement area, while a red marker indicates an incompatible area. 

[img]https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExbWwybXdraXJoN3VmcjFqNzQ0dm91c3lnNmd6MTBpaXliODBhNGZ2dSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/v03vfeiA6IqMy4MLFs/giphy.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExNHNiZHNuOXlkYmVuMzdtaHVndGJuc2hndzQyN3RzMWw4c3B4MTljbSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/fIPaNsBUNnNW633cwu/giphy.gif[/img]

In addition, cargo now has a weight, which will directly affect the behavior of boats and ships: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/7ce2332404c9b98602bdbc1f3bf771cce79de8c6.png[/img]

During the public testing phase, we’ll continue to work on additional tasks and refine key areas of the new cargo and mission system to ensure a smooth experience. Please note that you currently do not earn XP points for cargo. In co-op mode, we also plan to introduce the ability to pass cargo from hand to hand, adding a new layer of teamwork and interaction to cargo management.

[h1]Reworked Sonar System[/h1]
We are excited to announce the introduction of multiple sonar modes for the first time in our games. This new system adds depth and realism to your maritime adventures. It enhances the process of locating and identifying fish, making your fishing expeditions feel more authentic and immersive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/3185ce57e003d8264732b3bc6a720b69752dd1c2.png[/img]

[h3]Our reworked sonar system will include three distinct modes:[/h3]

[olist]
[*][b]History Sonar:[/b] Track fish beneath your vessel
[*][b]360 Sonar/Area Scan[/b]: Provides a full panoramic scan of your surroundings to target school of fish 
[*][b]Forward Sonar[/b]: A forward-facing sonar for detecting fish and obstacles ahead of your vessel
[/olist]
In [b]version 0.7.5[/b], we’re taking a closer look at the [b]History Sonar[/b] mode, designed for Tier 1 and 2 boats and ideal for longline and net fishing. The 360 Sonar and Forward Sonar modes in update v0.8 will be exclusive to Tier 3 fishing vessels, offering essential tools for the [b]Purse Seine[/b] fishing technique. 

[previewyoutube=981myc57au4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]The History Sonar displays:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Mode:[/b] Clearly indicates which sonar mode you are using. 
[*][b]Map Integration:[/b] The map display is now be moved to the sonar, providing players with all the necessary navigation and fish-tracking information in one interface.
[*][b]Max Depth:[/b] Displays the total depth being scanned. You can adjust the total depth being scanned to focus on specific areas, helping you target the most relevant zones for fish detection.
[*][b]Water Surface:[/b] The very top of the display represents the water's surface, helping you orient yourself as you track fish activity.
[*][b]Seabed:[/b] This shows the precise location of the seabed, which is crucial for understanding the topography beneath your vessel.
[*][b]Fish Zones:[/b] The most critical part of the display indicates the area where fish are commonly found. This zone is located between the water surface and just above the seabed. 
[*][b]Fish species indicator: [/b]If you're new to sonar or find it difficult to interpret raw sonar data, you can activate the fish species indicator. This feature will show you the types of fish detected, making it easier to understand what's below your vessel. 
[*][b]Zoom in/out:[/b] The History Sonar will also feature a zoom in and out option, allowing you to target the most relevant zone. 
[*][b]Adjust the screen brightness:[/b] For optimal visibility, no matter the time of day or sea conditions. 
[*][b]Clear Data:[/b] Some advanced sonar models automatically delete old historical data when the buffer reaches its capacity. They also provide a Clear Data button for manual control. Similarly, the sonar system in Ships At Sea automatically clears data but includes a Clear Data button that allows players to clear the history and view only new data.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=bSHNW946SQg;full][/previewyoutube]

With these new sonar features, [i]Ships At Sea[/i] will bring even greater depth and precision to your fishing expeditions, giving you the tools you need to master the seas and improve your catch.

[h1]Radio[/h1]
[i]Ships At Sea[/i] enhances your maritime experience by bringing online radio channels right to your boat's cockpit, allowing you to enjoy your favorite tunes while navigating the open waters.

[img]https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExYzBlejZrdTRlbXNwNTV3dWFlMDNvaWZ6MG5vMDZ5Yzc3MmRzbnBrbSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/Rzn0UqQavjl8elIGtu/giphy.gif[/img]
[h3]Radio controls in the wheelhouse:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Switch Sources:[/b] Use the source button on the radio asset to toggle between in-game music and your favourite radio channels.
[*][b]Audio Management:[/b] You can easily turn the radio or music on and off, adjust the volume, skip tracks or radio channels as desired and even loop the music. 
[*][b]Favorite Channels:[/b] Use the mode button to save your top 6 favorite radio channels for quick access by using the designated slots from 1 to 6.
[/list]
[h3]To add custom radio channels, head to the Settings menu:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Navigate to the [b]Settings[/b]
[*] Enter the link for your desired radio channel
[*] We support various formats including [b]mp3, aac-lc, he-aac v1, and he-aac v2[/b]
[/list]
[h3]And that´s not all -  we’ve added several preset online radio channels for you to enjoy right away:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Simulator Radio
[*] Truck Stop
[*] Simulator FM
[*] Simulator Vibe
[*] Simulator Hits
[/list]
[h1]Radar[/h1]

Radar is a crucial tool for navigation, as it enables the detection of nearby ships and land obstacles. It also provides information about the distance and direction of other objects, which is essential for collision avoidance at sea and near the shore. With radar, captains can confidently navigate through challenging conditions—whether in darkness or adverse weather—ensuring safe passage even when visibility is low.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/042a76ef1a3856f2fd3b91d70ae858f7989bb652.png[/img]

[h3]Understanding your Radar Screen: Key Features and Details[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/daad0b485c852840199bd925badb8dfa16880688.png[/img]

[h3]Radar Features: Navigating with Precision[/h3]

Our radar system offers a range of configurable functions to enhance your navigation experience. With adjustable sensitivity, sea and weather clutter suppression, and tools for measuring distance and bearing, the radar keeps your route clear and precise. You’ll be able to track the position of your ship and nearby vessels and use NAV lines and markers to maintain the course. The system also supports both Relative Motion (RM) and True Motion (TM) modes, giving you more control and situational awareness on the open water.

[h3]Control Panel[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/8211c48a25af6e72fd32a59049936f7aab58a7f9.png[/img]

[code][olist]
[b][*]Clear: Clears the scanned data. Operates in standby mode only
[*]Scan Depth Normalization Range: Controls the range within which data normalization takes place. Values above this range will be clamped to the maximum value.
[*]Scan Depth: Controls the maximum scanning depth
[*]Gain: Adjusts receiving sensitivity
[*]SEA: Removes sea clutter
[*]RAIN: Removes rain/snow clutter
[*]Range: Switches the scan distance range
[*]FUNC: Switches the modes for displaying the ship's position in space. RM_Head Up, RM_North Up, and TM_Head Up, TM_North Up modes if supported by the system configurations.
[*]Brill: Switches the brightness of the screen
[*]Variable Range Marker Distance (VRM) (Range Rings): Controls the display range of the distance rings
[*]STBY: Pauses the scan image update
[*]TX/PRF: Starts/Stops transmitting
[*]Traffic Toggle: Toggles the display to show the icons of neighbouring ships and their direction
[*]EBL Toggle: Switches the display of the electronic bearing line
[*]EBL Angle +: Increases the angular deviation of the electronic bearing line
[*]EBL Angle -: Decreases the angular deviation of the electronic bearing line[/b]
[/olist][/code]

[h1]Net Fishing Updates[/h1]

We’ve made some exciting improvements to the net fishing experience! Fish caught in the nets now display more realistic movement, with enhanced physical behavior for greater immersion. To help with untangling, we’ve introduced the [b]Yarn Hook[/b], available for purchase at the port shop, which you can use to free fish from the nets. Please note that the untangling pillars are currently temporary and will be replaced soon.

We’re also rolling out the first iteration of our [b]Gutting Fish[/b] mechanic. While animations and the gutting knife are still missing, this feature marks an essential step toward adding more depth to the fishing process. Expect further refinements as we continue to improve the net fishing system for an even more immersive experience.

To untangle the fish, use the Yarn Hook:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/b11ca3a5d1837669cd3b35146ecbdf6dac6abef7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/d5fe96aea8f286e2d62d1a9c2a5774d306345c1c.png[/img]

To gut the fish, interact with the gutting table equipped on the Tier 2 fishing boat: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/3117429fee674adbb802f1ddd3be72dd5f5aa5a4.png[/img]

[img]https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExbXdjc3g3dWJtNXdvaTBwd29neTBzdmgwaWNmc3J0bG8xc24xaW1tNiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/4gba9ghYGDIAd9IUII/giphy.gif[/img]

As we open up [b]Update v0.7.5[/b] for [b]Public Testing[/b], we’re thrilled to share our ambition of creating the next generation of ship simulation. With the introduction of co-op play, you’ll now experience an added layer of teamwork, navigating the challenges of the sea alongside friends. Our goal is to immerse you in the true feeling of life at sea, capturing the depth and complexity of the maritime world with fully functioning instruments, realistic navigation, and the authentic challenges of the open ocean. While you explore and test these new features, we’ll be hard at work refining and expanding SAS to make it the ultimate maritime experience. We also look forward to hearing your feedback—it’s invaluable in helping us craft a game that resonates with you and maritime enthusiasts everywhere.

notes.title: Update v0.8 Sneak Peek and Public Test Announcement
notes.content:
Ahoy, Captains!

We've been hard at work on Ships At Sea, and while we know you're eagerly awaiting the release of update v0.7.5, we wanted to give you a sneak peek of something new coming with [b]update v0.8[/b]: The [b]Technical Room[/b]!

[h3]New Feature - The Technical Room (Coming in v0.8)[/h3]
Larger ships offer more space, allowing for dedicated areas for specific functions. In [b]v0.8[/b], Tier 3 ships will include the Technical Room, a critical area for managing and maintaining the vessel’s systems. You might be wondering about the engine room—this will be introduced with Tier 4 ships, which are planned for release next year. Our ultimate goal for larger vessels is to have all supported instruments, engines, and equipment connected to either the technical room or the engine room, ensuring comprehensive system control and enhancing the ship simulation experience.

[previewyoutube=_3FwMjZ1Sbo;full][/previewyoutube]

Here’s what to expect:
[list]
[*] [b]Switchgear Cabinets:[/b] As you navigate the open seas, the components in these cabinets will gradually wear down and break, requiring your attention for repairs and maintenance, or else the ship cannot function properly. 
[*] [b]Connected Systems:[/b] All respective instruments in the wheelhouse will be connected to the technical room. 
[*] [b]Monitoring:[/b] As a crew or captain you must monitor the technical room for potential system failures and respond quickly to prevent any issues that could impact your journey.
[/list]
This is just the beginning of the larger ship systems overhaul, with much more to come! We are now laying a foundation for the future, and since everything is built on a module-based system, expanding new features or gameplay can easily be done. In addition, the future mod support will also benefit from all the work we do now. 

[h3]Why the Delay in v0.7.5?[/h3]
We realize that you eagerly awaiting the update v0.7.5, and we apologize for the delay. Our main focus is on providing an immersive experience, particularly in terms of co-op/competitive play. We are actively working hard to address and resolve as many of the issues as possible that you have reported since the Early Access release.

Here’s what we’re improving:
[list]
[*] We are overhauling the Cargo/Mission/Tutorial Systems to provide a smoother experience. This includes the ability to stack cargo and to lay the foundation for future container handling, save cargo, and resolve issues where cargo deliveries weren't recognized, and much more. 
[*] Players can now take on multiple missions without issues, improving mission flow and gameplay. Additionally, the ability to complete missions together in co-op on the same boat. 
[*]And a lot more...
[/list]
[h2]Public Test for Update v0.7.5[/h2]
While we’re continuing to polish and finish up the remaining tasks for [b]v0.7.5[/b], we’d like to invite you to join an [b]Public Test [/b]soon. During the Public Test, you can test the completed features and provide us with feedback. Your input is invaluable as we work towards making [b]Ships At Sea[/b] the best it can be. Stay tuned for more details!

We appreciate your patience and can’t wait to hear your thoughts on these new features.


Fair winds and following seas,

- Team Misc Games

notes.title: Introducing the Tier 2 Crane - Coming in Our First Major Update!
notes.content:
Ahoy Captains, 

We recently unveiled the new Tier 3 ships that are planned to be released with the first major update, and many players have shown keen interest in being able to operate cranes directly on their vessels. 

We are pleased to announce that we will be meeting this demand with the introduction of the new [b]Tier 2 Crane[/b]. This crane is designed to handle not only medium cargo but also the new large cargo types, making it the perfect tool for the more demanding tasks that come with larger ships.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/52fd3bd3ea94f7069334ab61e6757b33798124f7.png[/img]

Rigged on both the Tier 3 Cargo and Fishing Ship, the Tier 2 Crane is essential for those looking to enhance their operational efficiency and tackle bigger challenges. As we prepare for the first major update, this powerful crane will play a key role in making your fleet more versatile and capable, perfectly complementing the increased capacity of the Tier 3 ships. Get ready to elevate your maritime experience with the Tier 2 Crane!

[img]https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExeHBpZW45Z3NoNTA0ajA5eGhtbnJna2lxYWw4Nzc2anlqbWw4NTVsMyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/tGrHto5Rf0tLfcMBtT/giphy.gif[/img]

As we gear up for the first major update, which introduces the highly anticipated Tier 2 Crane and Tier 3 Ships, we’re also hard at work preparing a minor update that will roll out before then. notes.title: Unveiling the Big One - Introducing the Tier 3 Fishing Vessel!
notes.content:
Sneak Peek, Captains!

We are excited to give you a glimpse of what´s coming in our November update - the [b]Tier 3 Fishing Vessel[/b], a true classic from the 1950s! This impressive vessel is approximately 19 meters long and is ideal for those who are ready to take their fishing experience to the next level.

notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
Ahoy, sailors!

This is a small update to some of the boats to improve their behavior in rough seas.

Driving a boat at full speed during bad weather is dangerous due to our realistic buoyancy system, which shows how boats behave in rough conditions. High speeds make boats unstable and hard to control in turbulent waters, increasing the risk of capsizing or swamping. Waves and strong winds can lift and toss the boat, similar to how objects lose stability in turbulent fluids. Slower speeds improve maneuverability and control, allowing safer navigation through rough seas. Therefore, reducing speed during bad weather is crucial for safety and stability.

[b]Changelog[/b]
[list]
[*] Balanced Conquest, Røster, Fixer and Skarven, should now perform better in rough seas
[/list]

- Team Misc Games

notes.content:
Ahoy, sailors!

A next wave of fixes and improvements to enhance your maritime experience. Please see below for a detailed look at what's included in this patch.

[h2]Date and Time Format[/h2]
We have added the option to customize your date and time formats. You can now choose between ISO (international standard), USA, and EU date formats. Additionally, you are able to switch between 24-hour and 12-hour time formats according to your preference.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/7ac8bdc8f1dfba478211c4942bff9218a19b85f7.png[/img]


[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added additional collision geometry beneath the net hauler sorting table to prevent fish from passing through the table surface
[*]Added options to choose the date and time format in the settings menu. Date and Time are no longer formatted in the local timezone.
[*]Adjusted the number of traps on fish during net hauling
[*]Adjusted the spawn location when entering Tier 2 Cargo Boat, to avoid getting stuck when fully loaded
[*]Despawned physical fish from the fish box after completing net fishing while retaining them in the boat inventory for selling.
[*]Fixed a bug where the timers for bank loans, fines, and insurance were not being restored correctly from savegames.
[*]Fixed a potential crash with the sonar
[*]Fixed crash when updating fish habitat or map marker 
[*]Fixed crashes related to fines
[*]Fixed GPU crashing when scrolling through ship upgrades
[*]Fixed potential crash when returning with a boat full of fish
[*]Fixed emissive materials for the boats Røster and Conquest
[*]Improved calendar and time management systems
[*]Improved fish attachment to the fishing net, resulting in smoother behavior of large fish when pulled through the net hauler
[*]Improved net hauling visuals by representing all caught fish of the same species with a single physical fish, which means losing that fish results in losing the entire catch of that species.
[*]Improved wave buffer management and water simulation stability to reduce visual artifacts, ghost waves, and streaking during rapid camera movements
[*]Implemented the concept of ageing fishing nets. As time passes, the nets should be able to catch more fish.
[*]Increased emissive output of the net untangle marker material (spikes) to enhance visibility at night
[*]Only consider fish sizes when hauling the fishing net that actually occurs in the catch from the habitat
[*]Prevented weather extrapolation during overrides to fix issues with extreme waves and sudden weather changes around storms. Shore waves are now fixed in size and no longer tied to the Beaufort scale to eliminate unnatural fast-moving waves
[*]Restricted which fish species can be caught using longlining and net fishing
[*]We have improved a few of the port areas and expanded accessible regions for players to explore on foot
[/list]

We hope that this update enhances your gaming experience. We will continue our work and aim to resolve the issues between the client and the host soon, especially related to net fishing mechanic. 
We wish everyone a great start to the new week!

notes.title: New update v0.7.1 with many improvements
notes.content:
Ahoy, sailors!

We are excited to unveil the next wave of fixes and improvements to enhance your maritime experience. Please see below for a detailed look at what's included in this patch. 

In addition, we'd like to address the GPU-related crashes you've reported. To better understand and solve these crashes, we've made adjustments to our crash reporting system to gather more information. We've added an option to play Ships At Sea with GPU crash debugging.

We'd like to ask for your help in investigating this by selecting [b]Play SAS (with GPU Crash Debug)[/b], if you are experiencing frequent crashes on computers above the minimum requirements for running Ships At Sea.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/b5a8842d11260a39bd93191db98553c372ca1ca0.png[/img]

[h2]Autopilot[/h2]

The first version of our autopilot system has been added. You can use it by plotting a route on the map, and then turning on the autopilot in the cabin. Your boat will then automatically follow the plotted route. You can manually adjust the throttle to maintain a good cruising speed and fuel economy.

[h2]Savegames[/h2]

We are currently addressing the reported savegame issues. This is a complex task and will take some time to resolve in order to prevent any impact on your current savegames. Please note that your inventory will be reset in this update due to our inventory improvements and skill tree options. We are very sorry for any inconvenience this may cause.

Keep in mind that you can't save the game while you are in the shipyard. We suggest that you save your game when you are docked in a port and have finished your cargo missions to avoid any issues when you load your savegame. We aim to roll out a fix for this and the net fishing by the end of next week! We have also added an auto-save option. 

[h2]Roadmap[/h2]

We plan to continue with weekly updates for the time being, rather than our recent daily updates, to ensure more robust updates and improvements. We look forward to sharing our upcoming roadmap, which will outline our plans and provide a sneak peek into what's next in our game, Ships At Sea, very soon!

notes.title: Ships At Sea
notes.content:
Ahoy, Navigators!

We're excited to announce that the Early Access version of our highly anticipated game, [b]Ships At Sea[/b], is now available! After months of hard work, dedication, and invaluable feedback from our community, we're ready to set sail with you on this incredible new simulation adventure.

[previewyoutube=Wp8lT01p9CM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]What is Ships At Sea?[/h3]

Ships at Sea is a captivating ship simulator that allows you to take command of various vessels such as cargo, service, and fishing boats. You can navigate treacherous waters and experience the life of a mariner. With stunning graphics, licensed boats and equipment, and a richly detailed world, the game promises to immerse you in the maritime world like never before. Additionally, Ships at Sea includes a multiplayer mode for up to 4 players, where each player has their own boat to complete tasks, and one player hosts the game. This setup allows you to explore and navigate the open seas with friends, enhancing the simulation experience. Co-op functionality is currently in development and will be featured after the Early Access release.

[h3]Why Early Access?[/h3]

Early Access allows us to open our docks to you, our dedicated players, to help shape the final stages of development. Your feedback is crucial in ensuring that Ships At Sea becomes the ultimate ship simulation experience. Don't worry if you start on a small boat, just like in real life, everyone begins their journey with a modest vessel. During our Early Access period until the final version, you will progress and unlock the next level of your boat class certification, you'll gain access to larger and more powerful ships. Each new boat class offers tailored gameplay features. Your ultimate goal is to command these impressive vessels:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/ca974ca76ffd8133bafafb20ed7ff1086011ca2b.png[/img]

[h3]What's Included in Early Access?[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Realistic Ship Handling:[/b] Experience the thrill of piloting 7 different boats, with more to come during the EA period.
[*][b]Detailed Environments[/b]: Navigate through different weather conditions, day-night cycles, and dynamic water and buoyancy physics. 
[*][b]Career Mode:[/b] Start as an amateur sailor and progress to become a captain navigator, undertaking various missions and challenges.
[*][b]Exploration:[/b] Discover ports and enter the shipyard.
[*][b]Multiplayer Mode:[/b] Team up with up to 3 friends in a multiplayer experience where one player hosts the game. 
[/list]

[h3]Your Feedback Matters[/h3]

We are committed to making Ships At Sea the best it can be, and we can't do it without you. Join our community on [url=https://discord.gg/K53yAnZJtH]Discord[/url]. Thank you for your continued support. Together, we'll navigate the uncharted waters and create something truly special.

Fair winds and following seas, 

- Team Misc Games

notes.title: Camera Zoom
notes.content:
Ahoy, Captains!

We are excited to announce a new feature added to Ships At Sea: the Camera Zoom option in the boat wheelhouse! This new functionality is designed to enhance your navigation experience, making it easier than ever to command your vessel with precision.

[b]What’s New?[/b]
The Camera Zoom feature enables dynamic adjustment of the view within the wheelhouse, providing control at your fingertips for a closer look at instruments or a wider view of the horizon.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExdDVxajRvdHA4djRpbjNxNmFiaGtvMHdiZGE1NWFhOTZkcTlvaDhzYSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/qIK3E1TIP6pCGdFXAd/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExcmdodzZ1ZG91aGgwMzQyc2ZyN2N6a2ZzMmlueDc2dzRzdjg4djFpcyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/IValIclHQI4PRFYZRu/giphy.gif[/img]

[h3]Key Features[/h3]

[b]Enhanced Visibility:[/b]
[list]

[/list]
[b]Smooth Controls:[/b] 
[list]
[*]The zoom function provides a seamless transition between different zoom levels.
[*]Easily accessible via your RMB, making zooming in/out quick and hassle-free.
[/list]
[b]Immersive Experience[/b]
[list]
[*]Enjoy a more immersive maritime experience as you can now focus on the details of the wheelhouse or take in the panoramic views from the wheelhouse.
[*]This feature adds a new layer of realism, making your time at the helm even more engaging.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/1f3d58551df4e58ba8cf0b551a3ca073a32bb66a.png[/img]

This feature not only makes navigation easier but also enhances the overall gameplay experience, allowing you to fully immerse yourself in the role of a captain.

As always, we value your feedback and invite you to join our community by visiting [url=https://discord.gg/K53yAnZJtH]Discord[/url]. Your insights help us make Ships At Sea the ultimate maritime simulation game. 

Stay tuned for more updates and happy sailing!

- Team Misc Games

notes.title: Update on Our Journey!
notes.content:
Dear Players and Supporters,

We hope this message finds you well. At Misc Games, we are committed to delivering an exceptional maritime experience. With this commitment in mind, we would like to share an important update regarding the release of the Early Access version of [b]Ships At Sea[/b].

Last week, Unreal Engine 5.4 was released, introducing a range of new features and improvements with the potential to significantly enhance both game performance and visual fidelity. After careful consideration, we have decided to upgrade our game to this latest version of the engine. As a result, we are rescheduling the release of our Early Access version to [b]May 23rd[/b] to allow our team the necessary time to upgrade, integrate, and optimize the new engine version.

We understand that this change may come as a disappointment to many of you who have been eagerly awaiting the chance to play Ships At Sea. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and are  grateful for your patience and continued support.

Rest assured, we are fully committed to utilizing this additional time to enhance the game’s mechanics, and overall stability. We believe these improvements will be well worth the wait.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/a874201d656d95a0f5a6ae0cf64a2cee83ea4a53.png[/img]


- Team Misc Games

notes.title: Introducing the Shipyard in - Ships At Sea
notes.content:
[h3]Unlock a New Level of Gameplay with the Shipyard![/h3]

Ahoy, Sailor's!

Welcome to the latest update on [b]Ships At Sea[/b]. In Ships At Sea, you navigate the vast oceans and manage the intricate details of sea travel. We are thrilled to introduce a new feature that will enhance your seafaring adventures - the fully functional Shipyard. This addition is designed to improve your gameplay and deepen your engagement with every aspect of ship management.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/c177bfb05fd41efd957f1934086af0d39f11c838.png[/img]

[h3]Upgrades and Customizations[/h3]

Enhance your boat’s capabilities by upgrading various components at the shipyard. To upgrade or rig your boat, simply interact with the laptop located on the workbench in the shipyard. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/8ca71e7d19c353eaf08df6dd1ce170506ff8fa3f.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Searchlights: 
Brighten the night with powerful lights that can guide you through the darkest waters.

[*]Steering Wheel and Throttle Control: 
Customize your command center with our range of stylish steering wheels and throttle controls. While these upgrades are currently cosmetic, they add a personalized touch to your ship’s cockpit, enhancing your visual and immersive experience at sea.

[*]Propeller: 
Boost your speed and efficiency with advanced propeller options.
[/list]
These upgrades are just few examples, more options will be introduced to a later point. They will not only improve the performance or appearance of your ships but also add a layer of strategy as you decide how best to equip your vessel for the challenges ahead.

[h3]Keep Your Ship Pristine with the Power Washer[/h3]

After days and weeks at sea, every boat and ship starts to show the wear and tear of constant exposure to the elements. Use the power washer in the shipyard to remove the rust and dirt, keeping your ship looking as good as new. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/e4ea3028781fb670bb453052e3a61d474265d14e.png[/img]

[h3]Customize Your Captain at the Locker[/h3]

At the shipyard, you have the option to not only upgrade your vessel but also customize your appearance. Currently, there are preset clothing options available for different career paths that you can choose from. As the game continues to develop, we plan on expanding these options to give you the freedom to mix and match clothing and accessories. This feature will provide a more extensive wardrobe in the future, allowing you to create a unique seafaring persona.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/5614677a3231deec0f842e0cddb3c9a983b4f99b.png[/img]

[h3]Future Updates - Boat Repainting[/h3]

Looking ahead, one of the exciting features we're working on is the ability to repaint your boat. This feature will not be available for the Early Access release but is slated for inclusion in a future update. Players will be able to choose from a variety of colors by interacting with color bucket assets at the shipyard. This addition will allow you to customize your vessel’s appearance to your liking, adding another layer of personalization to your sea adventures. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/29cec85c1f66046aa03824ed926f9d1edb7ac9c0.png[/img]

Get ready to embark on uncharted waters! We are eagerly looking forward to hearing your thoughts and feedbacks. Join our community by visiting [url=https://discord.gg/K53yAnZJtH]Discord[/url] 

- Team Misc Games

notes.title: New Cargo Items
notes.content:
Ahoy, Cargo Masters!

In the busy ports and vast oceans of [b]Ships At Sea[/b], the key to any vessel's success is its cargo. We are thrilled to announce that we have added various new cargo options that will challenge even the most experienced shippers. Early Access sets sail with Tier 1 and Tier 2 cargo boats, laying the foundation for a thriving cargo transport service. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/432733563485ea6d6d819ddffdf89a024e43aefb.png[/img]

[h3]Embark on a Cargo Adventure: Master the Art of Load and Lift[/h3]

Begin your cargo transport journey by gaining practical experience in manual cargo loading. This fundamental skill is the stepping stone that will pave the way for your future as a cargo transport expert. Once you have mastered the basics, you will move on to the busy port where you will be in charge of a crane. This is where you will refine your skills in the crucial practices of dockside loading.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/b1ff35feb55c60687ac4a5f57d1fa85fe86217e4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/998729dfff3bd4d63297182546a6298a2c633068.png[/img]

As you sail through the Early Access waters, your cargo will grow in size and your operations will become more complex. You'll be in charge of larger cranes and steering bigger ships, all designed to meet the demands of your expanding logistics. This progression not only enhances the gameplay, but also introduces a variety of specialized cargo items with intricate details. Each new item not only adds layers of strategy, but also brings more joy to your nautical adventure.

Fair breezes and fruitful journeys lie ahead!

- Team Misc Games

notes.title: Redfish
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow sailors!

Get a sneak peek at the mysterious [b]Redfish[/b], one of the most fascinating features of our upcoming maritime adventure, [b]Ships At Sea[/b], set to launch in May 2024!

In the uncharted waters of Ships At Sea, every catch has a tale to tell, and the redfish is no exception. Renowned for its stunning color and deep-sea habitat, this fish is a perfect addition to our game, adding both beauty and realism. However, be warned, brave fishers, the redfish holds a secret beneath the waves that you may uncover.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/6ccb6f01e1dd92a19e2c1dccfb2f9d9561b89047.jpg[/img]

This not only adds a layer of detail to your fishing endeavors but also immerses you deeper into the life like dynamics of deep-sea fishing.

Take a sneak peek into our meticulous attention to detail in Ships At Sea. Watch our latest video showcasing this unique feature in action, and experience a thrilling and authentic voyage with us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/5f90b16b5527d53220a825b0da334560667d07e8.png[/img]

[h3]Extra Small Cargo: Compact and Efficient[/h3]
Master the art of efficiency with extra small cargo. These pint-sized parcels may be small in size, but they pack a punch when it comes to profits. Handle them with care and precision to make the most of your shipping ventures.

[h3]Small Cargo: Precision Matters[/h3]
In the world of cargo, precision is key. Small cargo items require your undivided attention as you manoeuvre them with finesse. Every move counts, so ensure your cargo arrives at its destination intact and on time to reap the rewards.

[h3]Medium Cargo: Find Your Balance[/h3]
With medium-sized cargo, finding the right balance between speed and safety is crucial. These goods may not be as delicate as small cargo, but they still demand a careful touch. Strike the perfect balance to optimize your shipping operations and profits.

Whether you're handling extra small, small, or medium cargo, [b]Ships At Sea[/b] challenges you to become a master of cargo logistics. Can you handle the varying cargo sizes with finesse and maximize your maritime fortunes? The seas await your skilled navigation and cargo-handling expertise!

notes.title: Ships At Sea - Development News #1
notes.content:
Ahoy sailors! 

Welcome to our first monthly developement news series! We're thrilled to have you on board for this exciting journey as we offer an exclusive sneak peek into the upcoming content of Ships At Sea. Together, we'll sail towards our highly anticipated Early Access release set for next year. Join us for the adventure!

A heartful thank you goes out to our incredible community and supporters who have been with us since the launch of our two previous games, Fishing: Barents Sea & Fishing: North Atlantic. With the help of the valuable experience, feedback, and suggestions we have received over the years, we are creating an upcoming title that will be the ultimate culmination of our dedication - a fantastic game and simulator centered around the marine world. 

[h1]Fish Farms[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/0423659807dfad435ae6c67911f584c606fb671a.png[/img]
Get ready for captivating Fish Farms and explore a variety of tasks tailored to different career paths. As a service boat player, you'll take charge of maintaining the fish farms net and feeding machine. Alternatively, as a cargo boat player, you'll be entrusted with delivering food to the fish farms or transporting live juvenile fish, known as smolt, in specialized containers. With each career path offering unique challenges and rewards, this dynamic gaming experience makes every task meaningful and exciting. 

[h1]Logbook[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/0a3b32ede5ee926aaea2cef7892c5eb5d61742d9.png[/img]
Your logbook isn´t just a journal, it´s your ultimate companion to track your daily catches, jobs, missions, upgrades, certificates, skills, statistics, crew, and more. The Logbook holds it all!

[h1]Fuel Station[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44144563/59e75e24138134ce9fc4d65bb66e6cfe38477d90.png[/img]
Navigate the high seas confidently and refuel your ship at strategically located fuel stations across the map. You can fill your ship with unleaded petrol or diesel, depending on your engine type. Diesel fuel is suitable for larger boat classes.



We hope that you share our excitement for this project and can´t wait to hear your thoughts and feedback on this news update, you can do so by joining our [url=https://discord.gg/K53yAnZJtH]Discord[/url] community. 

Misc Games Team
